## Tier 4.0 — Composite Vocabulary

### Def-BM.1 — Colour-sealed chain composites

**Def.** **Constituent** $:=$ a triplet-attached bound chain [D3.8: one fundamental slot index $q^i$ (or dual $r_i$) at the attachment; Def-H.4: a Janus-closed bound chain, terminus locus; $\delta h\ge2$]. **Junction** $:=$ a shared vertex hosting one elementary invariant contraction of the constituents' slot indices [CT3.17: $\delta^i{}_j$ for a pair, $\varepsilon_{ijk}/\varepsilon^{ijk}$ for a triple; trivalent slot structure CT3.2].
$$
\textbf{baryon:}\quad B(c_1,c_2,c_3)\ :=\ \varepsilon_{ijk}\,c_1^i\,c_2^j\,c_3^k\qquad[\mathrm{D3.9}\ \text{algebraic form, chain-realized at one junction}];
$$
$$
\textbf{meson:}\quad M(c,\bar c)\ :=\ \delta^i{}_j\,c^j\,\bar c_i\qquad[\mathrm{D3.9};\ \bar c:\ \text{the conjugate constituent}\ (\omega\text{-reversed chain with dual attachment},\ \mathrm{D2.6},\ \mathrm{D3.8})].
$$
**Validity clause.** For valid ambient $C$ [D2.11], $\pi_C$ is total on $\mathrm{Colour}(U)$ [CT3.18 $+$ D2.11 applied to the colour ledger; D2.14]: every attachment has its contraction partners inside the composite; a restriction $\Sigma$ with $\partial_{\mathrm{col}}(\Sigma;C)\ne\varnothing$ has $\mathcal C(\Sigma;C)=0$ and its entire colour sector vanishes [D2.14, FT.19: all-or-nothing] — the mask admits only singlets [CT3.18].
**Read clause.** Each constituent retains its own terminus tuple $(q,\mathbf S,m_{\mathrm{hid}})$ [Def-H.9]; the junction adds the sealing-phase class and the lock content [Census FT.49: $\Theta_{\mathrm{int}}\in4\mathbb Z$ at the baryon-type cell; Census FT.35: junction $D^-$ content]; the card assembly is Def-BM.2.

---

### Def-BM.2 — The composite card

**Def.** The **card** of a sealed composite refines the floor-card row template [Census FT.28 — the minimal fermion cell; every sealed-composite card refines its row grammar: registration data $(\sigma_e,\kappa)$, $\Theta_{\mathrm{int}}$, winding, holonomy, aspect rows, mask dimension, rung counts, ternary core read] with:
$$(1)\ \text{constituent rows: the}\ \Pi_v\ \text{projections of Def-H.9 per constituent};\qquad(2)\ \text{the junction row: sealing-phase class and lock content}\ [\mathrm{Def\text{-}BM.1}\ \text{read clause}];$$
$$(3)\ \text{the sealing-grammar row:}\ N_{\mathrm{strong}}=\log_2 g\bigl(|\mathrm{Colour}(\Sigma)|\bigr)\ \text{with the grammar counts}\ g\ [\mathrm{CT3.17a}(2)\text{–}(3);\ \mathrm{FT.41}(b)];$$
$$(4)\ \text{the sealing-profile row}\ [\mathrm{FT.34}(5)\ \text{partition rule}];\qquad(5)\ \text{the winding-ledger rows}\ [\text{additive composition}\ \mathrm{FT.34}(3);\ \text{Census FT.43},\ \text{FT.51}].$$
Card **values** are Census-cell data at the computed cells; card **grammar** is this definition. No card row is a species identification [P1, P5].

## Tier BM.1 — Observability of Sealed Composites

### BM.1 — Confinement inheritance and the trace-only read

**Thm.**
$$(1)\quad\textbf{sealing is the observability switch:}\ \ \text{a sealed composite is colour-complete on its own support}\ (\partial_{\mathrm{col}}=\varnothing\implies\mathcal C=1)\ \text{and its colour sector survives masking generically}$$
$$\qquad\bigl[\mathrm{FT.39}(1):\ \mathcal C=1\Rightarrow F^\Sigma_{\mathrm{strong}}=F_{\mathrm{strong}}|_\Sigma\ne0\ \text{generically, exact exception locus}\ \{f=0\}\cup\{\mathrm{Colour}=\varnothing\}\bigr];$$
$$\text{any unsealed constituent read vanishes: one dangling attachment zeroes the whole colour sector}\ [\mathrm{FT.19}];\ \neg\exists\ \text{triplet pole, physical norm}\ 0\ [\mathrm{CT3.22}];$$
$$(2)\quad\textbf{the one-body trace law:}\ \ \text{every Hermitian slot operator on a sealed singlet reads only its trace — baryon:}\ \mathfrak T(H)=3a\ \text{for the covariant class}\ H=aI_3+zP+z^*P^T;\ \text{meson:}\ 0\ \text{(including the trace part)}\ [\mathrm{FT.117}(1)\text{–}(3)];$$
$$\text{hence the}\ C_3\text{-doublet datum}\ (B,\theta)\ \text{is annihilated on every colour-sealed object, and hadron-level triplets cannot carry the family channel}\ [\mathrm{FT.117}(2),(7)];$$
$$(3)\quad\textbf{the sealed colour factor:}\ \ \text{singlet-sealed chains keep the undressed arena}\ 9\ \text{— the invariant lines are}\ 1\text{-dimensional}\ [\mathrm{FT.117}(5):\ \dim(\mathbb C^3)^{\otimes3\,\mathfrak{sl}(3)}=\dim(\mathbb C^3\otimes\bar{\mathbb C}^3)^{\mathfrak{sl}(3)}=1;\ \mathrm{Def\text{-}H.42}];$$
$$(4)\quad\textbf{the visibility locus:}\ \ \text{the same covariant data are nonzero on the adjoint channel}\ ([H,E_{12}]\ne0),\ \text{but the adjoint is not a sealed singlet and carries no pole}\ [\mathrm{FT.117}(4);\ \mathrm{CT3.18};\ \mathrm{CT3.22}]\ \text{— the constituent-level channel data}\ (\delta_q=\tfrac2{27}\ [\mathrm{FT.119}])\ \text{are ledger-internal at hadron level}. $$

**Req.** D2.11, D2.14, D3.8, D3.9 (Part 2); CT3.17, CT3.18, CT3.22 (Part 2); Def-BM.1; FT.19, FT.39, FT.116(3), FT.117, FT.119, Def-H.9, Def-H.42 (Part 3).

**Pf.**
$$
(1):\ \mathrm{Def\text{-}BM.1}\ \text{validity clause}:\ \pi_C\ \text{total}\implies\partial_{\mathrm{col}}(\Sigma;C)=\varnothing\ \text{on the composite's own support}\implies\mathcal C(\Sigma;C)=1\ [\mathrm{D2.14}];\qquad\mathrm{FT.39}(1):\ \text{generic nonvanishing with the exact exception locus}
$$
$$
\mathrm{FT.19}:\ \mathcal C=0\implies F^\Sigma_{\mathrm{strong}}=0\ (\text{one null factor kills the slot product});\qquad\mathrm{CT3.22}:\ \neg\text{triplet pole}\ \wedge\ \text{norm}\ 0
$$
$$
(2)\text{–}(3):\ \mathrm{FT.117}(1)\text{–}(3),(5)\ \text{verbatim at the composite support}:\ \varepsilon\ \text{spans}\ \wedge^3\mathbb C^3\ (\text{the determinant representation});\ \text{the one-body sum acts by}\ \mathfrak T(H)\ [\mathrm{CT3.16};\ \mathrm{CT3.7}:\ \mathfrak T(T_a)=0];\ \text{meson}:\ (H\otimes I-I\otimes H^T)\,\mathrm{vec}(I)=0\ [\text{machine rows re-cited}]
$$
$$
(4):\ \mathrm{FT.117}(4)\ \text{verbatim}:\ \text{adjoint}\notin\operatorname{Im}\mathcal P_M^{(3)}\ [\mathrm{CT3.18}];\qquad\text{ledger-internality}: (2)\text{'s annihilation on sealed supports}.\ \blacksquare
$$

**Phys.** Sealing is the observability switch: the colour sector becomes physical exactly when the $\varepsilon/\delta$ grammar completes — and then reads a single number, the trace. Everything the constituent ledger carries (channel angles, doublet data, spectator dressings) stays behind the seal: the hadron sees sums, never slots. This is confinement as an information property, run forward from the subnetwork theorems to the composite level.

$$(1)\quad\textbf{baryon-type sealing phase:}\ \ \text{at the computed baryon-type junction cell,}\ \Theta_{\mathrm{int}}\in4\mathbb Z\qquad[\text{Census FT.49};\ \text{per materialized closed chain}\ \Theta(c)\in2\mathbb Z,\ \mathrm{FT.22}];$$

(1):\ \text{Census FT.49's card row (computed from FT.22/FT.24's quantization on the tetrahedron-face sealing grammar)};\qquad\text{no new arithmetic}

What the junction does not add is new grammar: the sealing partitions are the frozen colour counts, and the gluing is the constraint-rank law the floor cells already proved.

## Tier BM.2 — The Family Group and the Invariance Laws of the Seal

### BM.3 — The family group of the seal

**Thm.**

### BM.7 — The discrete conservation law is Janus topology: no symmetry argument, no action, no limit

**Thm.**

$$\text{the D1.2 transition domains force strict alternation}\ (J^-\ \text{undefined at}\ n_{\mathcal R}=0;\ J^+\ \text{undefined at}\ n_{\mathcal R}=1):\ \text{the single-pair history of length}\ n\ \text{is unique}\ \forall n\ [\mathrm{FT.144}(2);\ \text{machine}];$$
$$\text{the completed history of length}\ 2m\ \text{is unique and balanced:}\quad(J^+J^-)^m,\qquad\#J^+=\#J^-=m\qquad[\mathrm{FT.144}(2),\ \mathrm{FT.156}(5);\ \text{machine}];$$
$$\text{the prefix law}\ \#J^+(\text{prefix})\ge\#J^-(\text{prefix})\ \text{holds on every admissible history, with equality}\iff n_{\mathcal R}=0\ [\mathrm{FT.144}(2);\ \text{machine}];\qquad\text{the pure order reversal of every nonempty completed history leads with}\ J^-:\ \text{inadmissible at its first event}\ [\mathrm{FT.144}(4)(\mathrm{ii});\ \text{machine}];$$
$$\textbf{the relaxation census}\ (\text{prefix law alone, alternation dropped}):\quad\#\{\text{completed words of length}\ 2m\}=\mathrm{Cat}_m=\frac1{m+1}\binom{2m}m=1,1,2,5,14,42\qquad[\text{machine, exhaustive}\ \le12];$$
$$\mathrm{Cat}_m>1\iff m\ge2:\ \text{the D1.2 domains are strictly stronger than the prefix law from}\ 2m=4\ \text{on}\ —\ \text{the uniqueness of}\ (1)\ \text{is domain content,}\ \neg\text{balance content};$$
$$\textbf{two pairs:}\quad\#\{\text{completed interleavings of total length}\ 2n\}=\sum_{m_0+m_1=n}\frac{(2n)!}{(2m_0)!\,(2m_1)!}=2,\ 8,\ 32\quad(2n=2,4,6)\qquad[\mathrm{FT.144}(2);\ \text{machine: exhaustive}];$$
$$\text{balance and the prefix law survive every interleaving}\ [\text{machine}];\qquad\text{the balanced sector is}\ a_+-a_-=|\mathcal R'|-|\mathcal R|=0\ \text{of the budget identity}\ [\mathrm{FT.108}(4)];$$
$$(2)\quad\textbf{the endpoint read is a boundary term, exactly:}\qquad q_{\mathrm{EM}}(c)=\frac{\sigma_{s(c)}-\sigma_{t(c)}}2\in\{-1,0,+1\}\qquad[\mathrm{D3.4},\ \mathrm{EM.9};\ \text{all three values attained}];$$
$$\textbf{the telescoping identity:}\quad\text{on a materialized chain}\ c=(e_1,\dots,e_k),\ \ t(e_i)=s(e_{i+1})\ [\mathrm{D1.4}]:\qquad q_{\mathrm{EM}}(c)=\sum_{i=1}^{k}j(e_i),\qquad j(e):=\frac{\sigma_{s(e)}-\sigma_{t(e)}}2\qquad[\text{machine: exhaustive}\ k\le7];$$
$$\text{interior vertex signs cancel pairwise; the sum is the difference of the two end reads}\ —\ \text{the charge at the start equals the charge at the end};$$
$$\textbf{the closed-chain read:}\quad\partial c=0\implies s(c)=t(c)\implies\sigma_{s(c)}=\sigma_{t(c)}\implies q_{\mathrm{EM}}(c)=0\ \text{exactly}\qquad[\mathrm{D1.4};\ \text{machine: every closed configuration}];$$
$$\text{total charge vanishes in every valid universe: each end is sealed against an oppositely oriented end carrying the same sign}\ [\mathrm{EM.11}];$$
$$(3)\quad\textbf{the ground is the chain complex, not an extremum:}\qquad\partial c:=t(c)-s(c)\ \text{(formal difference of vertices)},\qquad\partial^2=0\ \text{since}\ \partial(\text{vertex})=0\qquad[\mathrm{D1.4};\ \text{machine}];$$
$$\text{closed}\iff\partial c=0\ \wedge\ \#J^+=\#J^-\ [\mathrm{D1.4}];\qquad\ker\partial=\{\text{closed chains}\},\qquad\text{every boundary has total multiplicity}\ 0\ [\text{machine}];$$
$$\text{conservation is the kernel statement of an integer boundary map: no action functional, no variational derivative and no continuous parameter enters}\ (1)\text{–}(3);$$
$$(4)\quad\textbf{the Noether route is unavailable for this read (obstruction):}\qquad\text{a Noether charge requires a one-parameter group action}\ \mathbb R\to\operatorname{Aut}(\text{the read's value space})\ [\text{math}];$$
$$\text{the value space of}\ q_{\mathrm{EM}}\ \text{is the ternary set}\ \{-1,0,+1\},\ \text{so the action lands in}\ \operatorname{Perm}\{-1,0,+1\}=S_3\ [\mathrm{EM.9}];$$
$$U(1)=\varinjlim_m\mathbb Z/m=\mathbb Q/\mathbb Z\ \text{is divisible}\ [\text{math}]:\ \text{its image in a finite group is divisible, hence trivial}\ —\ \text{no transposition of}\ S_3\ \text{has a square root, no}\ 3\text{-cycle has a cube root}\ [\text{machine: the full root census of}\ S_3];$$
$$|\operatorname{hom}(\mathbb Z/m,S_3)|=\#\{g\in S_3:\operatorname{ord}(g)\mid m\}=1,4,3,4,6,6\ (m=1,2,3,4,6,12)\ [\text{machine}]:\ \text{every finite stage admits nontrivial homs, and the only projectively compatible family is the trivial one};$$

$$(5)\quad\textbf{priority:}\qquad(1)\text{–}(3)\ \text{are exact, discrete, integer-valued and hold at every scale, including}\ \mathfrak h\ne0;\qquad\text{the differential law}\ \partial_\mu J^\mu=0\ \text{is their continuum limit}\ [\mathrm{BM.11}]\ —\ \text{derived from them,}\ \neg\text{converse};$$

**Phys.** Charge conservation in this corpus is a fact about integers, not about symmetries. A valid universe is one in which every crystallization has its dissolution — the definition says so, and the transition domains make the completed history unique: seal, unseal, seal, unseal. The endpoint charge read telescopes: sum the per-edge source along a materialized chain and every interior sign cancels, leaving the two ends; close the chain and the read is exactly zero. The ground is a boundary map with $\partial^2=0$ — the kernel statement of an integer chain complex. And the Noether route is not merely unnecessary here, it is closed: the charge alphabet has three elements, so any continuous charge-rotation action would have to land in a three-element permutation group, and a divisible group has no nontrivial finite image. There is no $U(1)$ to rotate the ternary read, hence no Noether current to build it from. What the continuum limit delivers later is the density form of a law that already holds, exactly, at every cell size.

**Phys.** Three of the four continuum symmetries are already sitting in the register; the fourth is not, and the corpus says why. The hop is a translation with an exact error term: the commutator of position with the finite difference is minus the shift operator at every step size, and the binomial expansion hands over the derivative as its leading term, so the momentum generator and its canonical commutator are the $\ell\to0$ read of an identity that never needed a limit to be true. Rotation is stronger still: because the weak generator satisfies $X^3=X$, the exponential of $-i\theta X$ is a quadratic polynomial in $X$ with $\cos\theta$ and $\sin\theta$ as coefficients, and the group law holds as a ring identity — the $120^\circ$ seal rotation and the $180^\circ$ transpositions are just two rational points of a one-parameter group that was there all along, with integer weights making the periodicity exact. The gauge algebras were never discrete: $\mathfrak{su}(2)$, $\mathfrak{su}(3)$ and the rung-2 centre close as Lie algebras over the rationals, and what the continuum adds is the gauging, not the algebra. Time is the exception, and it is an honest one — the tick has no inverse and the ledger dynamics strictly contracts its Lyapunov function at every admissible threshold, so the microscopic theory has no exact time-translation symmetry and the energy charge exists only under a declared stationarity scope, which the sealed sector satisfies structurally. The charge ledger then splits three ways: colour reads zero on every sealed singlet, weak isospin reads the derived Casimir, and electric charge is not a Noether charge at all.

The same tensor is the translation current: its divergence is the field equation times the field gradient, an identity in the jet variables that vanishes on-shell — Noether's theorem, run in reverse from the symmetry the hop promoted. For the neutron, the fully sealed three-juncture in the neutral class, the bound-part form collapses to $\mathrm{diag}(\rho,0,0,0)$: static, spherically symmetric, pressure-free, exactly the $D^-$ equation of state, and satisfying every energy condition at $\rho\ge0$. And because the width is strictly positive, the source is a distribution, not a point: the smoothing scale is where the coarse-graining hypothesis of the continuum limit takes over.

**Phys.** The uncertainty principle is not in the sixteen matrices, and the corpus proves it cannot be: every commutator in a finite dimension is traceless while the target $i\mathbb1$ is not, so no position–momentum pair lives in the register, in any spin representation, or anywhere else finite. What the register does carry is the discrete predecessor — a clock and a shift whose commutation phase is a root of unity, order four on the pair channel and order sixteen on the arena, torsion at every finite size. The genuine pair appears one level up, on the continuum chart, where multiplication and covariant differentiation are unbounded and Robertson's inequality delivers $\Delta x\,\Delta p\ge\tfrac12$ with the constant attained exactly by the ground state and the width growing as $n+\tfrac12$. The other two conjugate pairs come with their own obstructions and their own correct forms: there is no self-adjoint time operator — the tick has no inverse and a semibounded generator forbids one — so the time–energy bound holds in Mandelstam–Tamm form, saturated by an exact two-level witness; and there is no angle operator, so the angular bound holds in the Carruthers–Nieto form, while the naive $\Delta\theta\,\Delta L\ge\tfrac12$ is refuted outright by any angular-momentum eigenstate. At the seal itself the rotation group is the cyclic three, which has three characters and no continuous angle at all: the angle is born in the promotion. What the width then buys is the composite's extent — a strictly positive volume, a finite density, and a stress-energy tensor that is a distribution rather than a spike.

$$(1)\quad\textbf{the Born width:}\qquad\Delta x_{\mathrm B}\ :=\ \frac1{m_{\mathrm{hid}}}\ =\ \frac{\mathfrak h}{E_{\mathrm{int}}\ln2}\qquad[\hbar=c=1,\ \mathrm{D2.9};\ \text{the Compton-like length of}\ \mathrm{FT.90}(6)\ \text{re-cited as an existing read}];$$
$$\textbf{constitutive clause:}\ \ \Delta x_{\mathrm B}\cdot m_{\mathrm{hid}}=1\ \text{is the definition};\qquad\textbf{non-derived clause:}\ \ \text{the dimensionless normalization is fixed to}\ 1\ \text{(the Compton normalization),}\ \neg\text{derived};$$
$$(2)\quad\textbf{the dimensional-uniqueness clause:}\qquad\exists!\ \text{free dimensionful scale}\ \mathfrak h\ [\mathrm{P1},\ \mathrm{CT2.11}]:\ \ \forall Q\ \text{dimensionful}:\ Q=c_Q\,\mathfrak h^{k_Q},\ c_Q\ \text{fixed}\ [\mathrm{CT2.11}];$$

$$\text{the Born width is the unique such length at}\ c=1;\qquad\text{any other}\ c\ \text{is a P4-class internal choice and is priced, not adopted}\ [\text{clause}\ (4)];$$
$$(3)\quad\textbf{the coherence volume:}\qquad V_{\mathrm{eff}}\ :=\ (\Delta x_{\mathrm B})^3\ =\ \frac{\mathfrak h^3}{(E_{\mathrm{int}}\ln2)^3}\qquad[\alpha=1:\ \text{the cube convention}];$$
$$(4)\quad\textbf{the geometric-factor clause (priced, not adopted):}\qquad V=\alpha\,(\Delta x_{\mathrm B})^3\ \text{with}\ \alpha\ \text{dimensionless}:\qquad\rho(\alpha)=\rho(1)/\alpha,\qquad\alpha=\tfrac{4\pi}3:\ \rho\mapsto\tfrac3{4\pi}\rho\ \ \text{exactly};$$
$$\text{every ratio in which}\ \alpha\ \text{appears in both entries is}\ \alpha\text{-free};\qquad\alpha\ \text{is}\ \neg\text{a dimensionful datum and}\ \neg\text{a P4 core member};$$

$$(6)\quad\textbf{the scope clause:}\qquad\mathrm{FT.90}(6)\ \text{refutes a Compton-wavelength relation to the generation threshold}\ (\delta h\ge\lceil\log_2\#\text{classes}\rceil\ \text{depends on the class count alone}):$$
$$\text{that refutation is untouched here}\ —\ \text{this definition uses the length as a spread read, and derives no relation between it and any threshold}.$$

**Rmk (naming).** *Born width* names the spatial spread of the sealed composite's density read at the Compton normalization; *coherence volume* names its cube. Both are internal bookkeeping on derived quantities [A §0.2]; neither is a measurement, and no external length datum enters [P5; Def-BM.3(6)].

$$2\pi\ln2>1\ [\text{machine: exact enclosures}\ \pi>\tfrac{223}{71},\ \ln2>\textstyle\sum_1^{12}\tfrac1{n2^n}]\implies\Bigl(\frac{\Delta x_{\mathrm B}}{\ell_R}\Bigr)^{\!2}>1\ \ \forall E_{\mathrm{int}}\ge1:\qquad\ell_R<\Delta x_{\mathrm B}\ \ \text{on the whole ladder};$$

$$(6)\quad\textbf{the}\ \Lambda\ \textbf{clause:}\qquad\Lambda\ \text{is a P4 core member}\ [\mathrm{P4}]:\qquad R\ \text{carries exactly one additive free term},\ 4\Lambda,\ \text{with exact coefficient}\ 4\ [\text{machine}];$$
$$\text{the locked part is}\ \kappa^2\rho=R-4\Lambda\ \ \text{at}\ p=0:\qquad\text{the curvature generated by the composite is calibration-locked; the ambient term is not}.$$

**Phys.** The mirror does something sharper than exchange two sectors. On the ledger it is an involution that reverses order and swaps the seal labels — and on a completed history those two acts cancel, so every completed word is fixed pointwise, while the same history read backwards with its labels intact is inadmissible at its first event. The formal mirror exists; the dynamical reversal does not. Weights conjugate exactly, because the phase alphabet is the fourth roots of unity: with $\alpha_e\in\{0,\pi\}$ and a half-integer line element, every edge weight is a sign times a power of $i$, and negating the winding conjugates it. The CPT phase is therefore one of four exact values, its modulus is one, and the amplitude is invariant unconditionally — with the on-shell refinement that the phase is real and the weight literally conjugates exactly when the edge count plus the winding is even. The census closes the picture: the two charged sectors carry identical weight at every winding, the neutral sector exactly twice either, which is the factorization's own $m_q=(2,1,1)$ and not a coincidence. On the baryon-type junction, whose phase class lives in $4\mathbb Z$, the whole CPT character collapses to a sign counting edges.

**Phys.** The charge constraint does exactly what a constraint on a sum does: it changes how many microscopic sign assignments land in each class. For one chain the neutral read has two realizations and each charged read one; for three chains bound by $q_1+q_2+q_3=Q$ the full census is $1,6,15,20,15,6,1$ across $Q=-3$ to $+3$, sixty-four assignments in all, and the neutral class ends up with twenty against the unit class's fifteen. That ratio, four thirds, is the whole content of the restriction. Whether it reaches the mass depends on what functional the mass is. A normalized ensemble average cannot see it — a uniform rescaling of the measure cancels between numerator and denominator, which is why the sector mass table is charge-degenerate as a matter of structure rather than luck. A total deficit can see it, and does: on that route the neutral class carries exactly four thirds the information content of either charged class, and is heavier. The amplitude layer carries a third ratio, fifty-eight thirteenths at zero winding and a different one at winding one, and its bridge to a mass read is still an open item. Two things survive every route: the proton and the antiproton stay degenerate, because the census is symmetric under charge conjugation and $(0,0,0)$ is the only self-conjugate triple; and no fractional charge can appear at all, since an integer sum of ternary reads cannot land on a third. What the corpus does not do is pick a route for the reader: all three are exact, all three are priced, and the choice is a read specification.

And the honest limit is stated rather than smoothed over — the corpus has equal-amplitude mirror sectors and no process connecting them, no annihilation and no production, because nothing in the inventory builds one.

## Tier BM.8 — The Additive Charge Read and the Mass-Route Adjudication

### Def-BM.8 — The additive charge read (the construction BM.6(1) specifies)

**Def.** A read $Q$ on sealed composites, constructed to BM.6(1)'s three specification clauses; no new axiom, no new datum.
$$(1)\quad\textbf{the read:}\qquad Q(c_1,\dots,c_k)\ :=\ \sum_{i=1}^{k}q_{\mathrm{core}}(c_i),\qquad q_{\mathrm{core}}(c)=\tfrac12\bigl(\sigma_{s(c)}-\sigma_{t(c)}\bigr)\in\{-1,0,+1\}\qquad[\mathrm{D3.4},\ \mathrm{EM.9},\ \mathrm{EM.9a},\ \mathrm{FT.40}];$$
$$(2)\quad\textbf{spec clause (i) — restriction:}\qquad Q|_{\text{single chain}}=q_{\mathrm{core}}\qquad[\text{immediate at}\ k=1];$$
$$(3)\quad\textbf{spec clause (ii) — additivity:}\qquad Q(\mathcal X\sqcup\mathcal Y)=Q(\mathcal X)+Q(\mathcal Y)\ \ \text{for disjoint sealings}\qquad[\text{the sum is over disjoint constituent sets}];$$
$$(4)\quad\textbf{spec clause (iii) — observability on sealed supports:}\qquad Q\ \text{is defined only where}\ \mathcal C(\Sigma;C)=1\ [\mathrm{D2.14}:\ \partial_{\mathrm{col}}(\Sigma;C)=\varnothing];\qquad\text{one dangling attachment zeroes the whole colour sector}\ [\mathrm{FT.19}]\ \text{and the read with it};$$
$$(5)\quad\textbf{the derived range and parity:}\qquad k=3:\quad Q\in\{-3,-2,-1,0,+1,+2,+3\}\subset\mathbb Z\qquad[\text{machine}];\qquad k=2\ (\delta\text{-seal}):\ Q\in\{-2,\dots,+2\};$$
$$\textbf{integer-valued at every}\ k:\qquad\tfrac13,\ \tfrac23\ \text{are unreachable}\ [\mathrm{BM.28}(7)];$$
$$(6)\quad\textbf{the probability-space weights it induces:}\qquad W(Q):=\#\{(\sigma\text{-assignments}):\ \textstyle\sum_iq_i=Q\}=\bigl[z^{Q}\bigr](2+z+z^{-1})^{k}\qquad[\mathrm{BM.28}(2);\ \text{machine}]:$$
$$k=3:\quad W=(1,6,15,20,15,6,1)\ \text{over}\ Q=-3,\dots,+3,\qquad\sum_QW(Q)=4^3=64\qquad[\text{machine}];$$
$$(7)\quad\textbf{the CPT action:}\qquad\mathrm{CPT}:\ q_i\mapsto-q_i\ [\mathrm{EM.24}(1)]\implies Q\mapsto-Q;\qquad W(Q)=W(-Q)\ [\text{machine}];\qquad\text{the unique CPT-fixed triple at}\ k=3\ \text{is}\ (0,0,0)\ [\text{machine}];$$
$$(8)\quad\textbf{status and scope:}\qquad\textbf{constructed}\ —\ \text{BM.6}(1)\text{'s specification is discharged for the sealed classes}\ k\le3;\qquad\text{the charge-class labels of}\ \mathrm{Def\text{-}BM.3}(4)\ \text{now rest on a derived read rather than on a declaration};$$
$$\neg\text{constructed: the coupling of}\ Q\ \text{to a gauge field}\ [\text{deficit}\ 1',\ \mathrm{FT.125}(4);\ \mathrm{FT.82}(7)(\mathrm a)],\ \text{and any dynamics of}\ Q\ [\mathrm{BM.6}(5)].$$

**Rmk (what the construction does not do).** $Q$ is a sum of the ternary end reads. It supplies no fractional constituent alphabet, no gauge coupling, and no mass: the mass routes are BM.28(4)'s and BM.30's, and the read-choice among them is not made here.

Two things come out of it that the specification did not ask for. The read is integer-valued at every constituent number, so a fractional charge is not missing from this corpus but unreachable by it. And the read carries its own statistics: the number of sign assignments realizing each net charge is the coefficient of a cubic generating function, giving twenty for the neutral class against fifteen for either unit class, which is the exact measure of how differently the charge constraint filters the two probability spaces.

**Phys.** One ensemble, three functionals, three answers — and all three are exact. Normalize and the charge constraint disappears, because a uniform rescaling of the measure cancels between numerator and denominator; that is why the sector mass table is charge-degenerate, and it is a structural fact rather than a lucky one. Sum instead of averaging and the constraint is all that matters: twenty sign assignments realize the neutral class against fifteen for either charged class, so the neutral composite carries four thirds the information deficit and weighs more. Take the amplitude layer and a third ratio appears, fifty-eight thirteenths at zero winding and something else at winding one, with its bridge to a mass read still open. What no route disturbs is the mirror: the census is symmetric under charge conjugation, so the proton and antiproton stay degenerate everywhere, and the seven crystallized reads stay blind to charge entirely. The corpus prices the three routes and adopts none, because adopting one is a read specification and not a theorem — and it records the ordering it does derive, neutral heavier, without comparing it to anything.

## Tier BM.9 — The Mesonic Flicker Test: the Contraction Grammar, the Colour Projector, and the Protected Junction

### Def-BM.9 — The extended flicker ensemble and the sealing filter

**Def.** A construction class on Def-BM.5 (no new axiom; Def-H.32's scopes (S1)–(S4) and Def-BM.5's inherited clauses stand).
$$(1)\quad\textbf{the two restricted ensembles:}\qquad\mathcal E_\varepsilon(\mathcal X):=\{R\in\mathcal E(\mathcal X):\ \text{the sealing of}\ R\ \text{is}\ \varepsilon_{ijk}\text{-type}\},\qquad\mathcal E_\delta(\mathcal X):=\{R\in\mathcal E(\mathcal X):\ \delta^i{}_j\text{-type}\}\qquad[\mathrm{D3.9};\ \mathrm{CT3.17}];$$
$$\mathcal E_{\mathrm{ext}}(\mathcal X):=\mathcal E_\varepsilon(\mathcal X)\cup\mathcal E_\delta(\mathcal X);\qquad\textbf{constitutive clause:}\ \text{the union is taken inside}\ \mathrm{Def\text{-}H.32}(1)\text{'s topology space, which is colour-blind}\ [\mathrm{D2.13}:\ \mathcal M(\Sigma)\ \text{is subject to the rung masks and Janus balance},\ \neg\text{to colour sealing}];$$
$$(2)\quad\textbf{the filter clause (the load-bearing one):}\qquad\text{colour sealing is ambient-global}\ [\mathrm{CT3.18}]\ \text{and acts}\ \textbf{downstream}\ \text{as the projector}\ \Pi_{\mathcal C}(\Sigma;C)=\mathcal C(\Sigma;C)\cdot\mathbb I^{(\mathrm{strong})}_\Sigma,\qquad\mathcal C(\Sigma;C)=\begin{cases}1&\partial_{\mathrm{col}}(\Sigma;C)=\varnothing\\0&\text{otherwise}\end{cases}\qquad[\mathrm{D2.14}];$$
$$\text{one dangling attachment zeroes the entire colour block}\ [\mathrm{FT.19}:\ \text{all-or-nothing}];\qquad\mathcal C\ \text{is an idempotent scalar},\ \mathcal C^2=\mathcal C\in\{0,1\}\ [\text{machine}];$$
$$\textbf{non-derived clause:}\ \ \text{none}\ —\ (2)\ \text{is}\ \mathrm{D2.14}\text{'s derived projector, cited at the site where the union of}\ (1)\ \text{would otherwise be read as a sum over sealings};$$
$$(3)\quad\textbf{the grouping grammar:}\qquad g(N):=\#\{\text{partitions of}\ N\ \text{attachments into contraction groups of size}\ 2\ (\delta)\ \text{and}\ 3\ (\varepsilon)\}\qquad[\mathrm{CT3.17a}(2);\ \mathrm{FT.41}(\mathrm b)]:$$
$$g(N)=(1,\,1,\,3,\,10,\,25,\,105)\quad\text{for}\ N=2,\dots,7\qquad[\text{machine: exhaustive partition enumeration reproduces all six values}];$$
$$g_\delta(N):=\#\{\text{groupings containing at least one}\ \delta\}=(1,\,\mathbf0,\,3,\,10,\,15,\,105),\qquad g_\varepsilon(N):=\#\{\text{groupings of}\ 3\text{-blocks only}\}=(0,\,1,\,0,\,0,\,10,\,0);$$
$$g_\delta(N)+g_\varepsilon(N)=g(N)\ \ \forall N\ [\text{machine}];\qquad g_\varepsilon(N)\ne0\iff3\mid N\ [\text{machine on the frozen range}];$$
$$(4)\quad\textbf{the boundary-data tuple:}\qquad\text{the labels that condition}\ \mathcal E(\mathcal X)\ \text{are}\ \bigl(Q,\ \Theta_{\mathrm{int}}\ \text{class},\ S,\ \text{attachment count}\ N\bigr)\ [\mathrm{Def\text{-}BM.5}(1);\ \mathrm{Def\text{-}BM.8}]:$$
$$\textbf{the attachment count is a boundary datum},\ \neg\text{a summed-over structure}\ —\ \text{a}\ 3\text{-junction and a}\ 2\text{-junction are different supports, not two members of one ensemble};$$
$$(5)\quad\textbf{the scope clause:}\qquad\text{no clause of this part sums over sealings of a fixed support as if they were alternatives}: \text{the grammar of}\ (3)\ \text{decides which sealings a support admits at all}.$$

**Rmk (why the filter, not a cancellation).** The topology-blind path integral is colour-blind by construction — that is what "topology-blind" means here [D2.13's scope note; CT3.22a Rmk]. Colour enters only through $\Pi_{\mathcal C}$, a $0/1$ projector applied after the sum. So the question "do $\delta$-sealed states cancel in the baryon's integral?" has a category answer before it has an arithmetic one: they are not terms that could cancel, they are terms the projector never admits.

**Req.** D2.13, D2.14, D3.9 (Parts 1–2); CT3.17, CT3.17a(2), CT3.18, CT3.22a (Part 2); Def-H.32 (Part 3); FT.19, FT.41(b) (Part 3); Def-BM.5, Def-BM.8 (this part); exhaustive set-partition enumeration over blocks of size 2 and 3, exact integer arithmetic [math; machine: `checks/verify_H_mesonic_flicker_test.py` §A].

**Pf.**
$$
\text{Definition block: the constitutive clause is}\ (1)\text{'s union inside the colour-blind topology space};\ (2)\ \text{is}\ \mathrm{D2.14}\text{'s projector re-cited at the site where the union is formed};\ (3)\text{'s counts are machine-reproduced from}\ \mathrm{CT3.17a}(2)\text{'s frozen list};\ (4)\text{–}(5)\ \text{are scope clauses}.\ \blacksquare
$$

**Phys.** Before any sum is taken, one structural fact settles the question. The topology-blind path integral does not filter by colour — it filters by topology, and colour enters afterwards as a zero-one projector on the support. A sealing is therefore not an alternative term competing inside one integral; it is a property of the support that either passes the projector or annihilates the whole colour block. And the grammar that decides it is small enough to enumerate: partition the attachments into groups of two and three, and count.

Their charge classes overlap on everything except $|Q|=3$, so the neutron's neutral class and the proton's unit class are shared with mesonic configurations; their phase classes differ only in half the cases, since $4\mathbb Z$ sits strictly inside $2\mathbb Z$; and their colour representation content is identical in the only respect that matters, one singlet line each. What does separate them is the attachment count, and it separates them absolutely: three attachments admit exactly one contraction grouping, the epsilon triple, and a delta sub-pairing would leave one attachment dangling, which the all-or-nothing law turns into a vanished colour block. That protection is not general — it is a property of the number three, and from four attachments upward the groupings genuinely mix, fifteen of twenty-five at six.

**Phys.** The answer to the test is zero, and the reason is more interesting than the number. Nothing cancels: there is nothing to cancel. A three-attachment support admits exactly one contraction, so the mesonic subset of its ensemble is empty before any weight is written down, and the colour projector would have annihilated those terms individually anyway — one dangling attachment and the whole block goes. Because the added weight is exactly zero, both mass functionals stay put: the normalized average and the total deficit are each invariant, so the curvature-flux mass and the four-thirds ratio of the previous tier survive the extension untouched. The amplitude-layer cancellations the corpus already proved are about a different object entirely — directed cycles in the skeleton — and they cut the other way: a standalone digon dies there, while dissolved digons inside covers are precisely what survives, with exact census weights. Mesons as sealed composites and mesonic chain content in covers are two different things, and the tier keeps them apart.

## Tier BM.10 — The Kinetic Energy from the Metric and the Vacuum-Balanced Entropy: the Dispersion Read of a Sealed Composite, the Deficit Reframing of the Rest Mass, the Force-Structure Ladder, and the Route-Artifact Adjudication

### Def-BM.10 — The metric-energy read of a sealed composite (the dispersion route)

**Def.** A read constructed on the chart side of a sealed composite from CT1.12's dictionary; no new axiom, no new datum, no new parameter. Local notation (internal bookkeeping): $\gamma_{ij}:=g_{ij}$ (the spatial block), $\gamma^{ij}:=$ the inverse matrix of the $3\times3$ block ($\gamma^{ik}g_{kj}=\delta^i{}_j$), $g^{\mu\nu}:=$ the inverse of the full $4\times4$ metric.
$$(1)\quad\textbf{locus and hypotheses:}\qquad\text{the read lives on the emergent chart}\ M\ [\mathrm{CT2.6}],\ \text{inheriting hypotheses (i)--(iii) at the point of use}\ [\text{A §0.2a}];$$
$$\text{the}\ 16\text{-dimensional pair register carries no canonical pair}\ [\mathrm{BM.10}(1)];\qquad\text{the register-side precursors are the discrete Weyl pairs}\ [\mathrm{BM.10}(2)]\ \text{and the width law}\ [\mathrm{BM.10}(6)];$$
$$(2)\quad\textbf{the metric data and the derived ADM split:}\qquad\text{for the coarse-grained sector coefficients}\ (a_{00},q_{ij},w_i)\ [\mathrm{D2.1}]:$$
$$\Omega=e^{\alpha_\Omega a_{00}},\qquad g_{00}=-\Omega^2,\qquad g_{0i}=\Omega^2\varkappa\beta w_i,\qquad g_{ij}=\Omega^2(\delta_{ij}+\varkappa q_{ij})\qquad[\mathrm{CT1.12};\ \mathrm{FT.157}(1)];$$
$$\textbf{lapse:}\quad N^2:=\Omega^2+\gamma^{ij}N_iN_j=-\frac{\det g}{\det\gamma}>0;\qquad\textbf{shift covector:}\quad N_i:=g_{0i}=\Omega^2\varkappa\beta w_i;\qquad\textbf{shift vector:}\quad N^i:=\gamma^{ij}N_j;$$
$$\textbf{the line element (an exact identity):}\qquad ds^2=-N^2d\tau^2+g_{ij}\bigl(dx^i+N^id\tau\bigr)\bigl(dx^j+N^jd\tau\bigr)=g_{\mu\nu}dx^\mu dx^\nu\qquad[\text{machine: Schur, denominators cleared}];$$
$$(3)\quad\textbf{the momenta:}\qquad\textbf{the unit-mass coordinate-time read:}\quad\pi_i:=g_{ij}\Bigl(\frac{dx^j}{dx^0}+N^j\Bigr)\qquad[x^0=\tau_n\ \text{the chart time};\ \mathrm{D1.8};\ \mathrm{FT.159}];$$
$$\textbf{the physical spatial momentum:}\qquad p_i:=m\,u^0\,\pi_i,\qquad u^\mu:=\frac{dx^\mu}{d\lambda},\qquad g_{\mu\nu}u^\mu u^\nu=-1;$$
$$\text{the shift contribution is}\ g_{ij}N^j=N_i=g_{0i}\ [\text{machine: exact polynomial identity}]:\qquad\text{the metric's time--space block enters the momentum exactly}\ [\mathrm{FT.157}(1)];$$
$$(4)\quad\textbf{the rest input:}\qquad m:=m_{\mathrm{hid}}=\frac{E_{\mathrm{int}}\ln2}{\mathfrak h}\qquad[\mathrm{FT.44}(4)\ \text{(Census)}];\qquad\text{the ensemble route:}\quad m\ \mapsto\ \langle m\rangle\ [\mathrm{BM.20}(3)];$$
$$\text{the vacuum-deficit reframing of the rest read is}\ \mathrm{BM.35}\ —\ \text{a marked forward pointer at the citing site, imported in no}\ \textbf{Req}\ \text{line};$$
$$(5)\quad\textbf{the mass shell and the energy:}\qquad g^{\mu\nu}p_\mu p_\nu=-m^2\qquad[\text{signature}\ (-,+,+,+);\ \mathrm{CT1.12}];$$
$$E:=-p_0\quad\text{is}\ \mathrm{BM.8}(2)\text{'s conditional energy read under its declared stationarity scope (theorem-local, inherited at the point of use)};$$
$$\textbf{the Eulerian form:}\qquad E=N\sqrt{m^2+\gamma^{ij}p_ip_j}-N^ip_i;\qquad\textbf{the kinetic-energy read:}\qquad \mathrm{KE}:=E-N\,m\ \ge0\ \ \text{where}\ g_{ij}\succ0\ [\mathrm{CT1.12};\ \text{machine}];$$
$$(6)\quad\textbf{status and scope:}\qquad\textbf{constructed}\ —\ \text{an abbreviation of derived objects:}\ (2)\text{'s split is linear algebra on}\ \mathrm{CT1.12}\text{'s dictionary};\qquad(3)\text{--}(5)\ \text{are pointwise identities}\ [\text{machine}];$$
$$\neg\text{a new parameter}\ [\text{§Cal-BM stays empty}];\qquad\neg\text{a declaration};\qquad\text{the names (lapse, shift, kinetic energy) are internal bookkeeping}\ [\text{A §0.2}];$$
$$\neg\text{constructed: the back-reaction of the composite's motion on its own sector coefficients}\ [\mathrm{BM.15}\text{'s read is the rest-frame one}]\ \text{and any inter-sector dynamics}\ [\mathrm{BM.29}(5)\ \text{stands}].$$

**Rmk (the unit-mass normalization).** The leading kinetic read is $\mathrm{KE}=\tfrac12N\,\gamma^{ij}p_ip_j/m+O(p^4)$: the factor $1/m$ is dimensionally forced, since $[\gamma^{ij}p_ip_j]=\mathfrak q^{+1}=\text{energy}^2$ while $[\mathrm{KE}]=\mathfrak q^{+1/2}=\text{energy}$ [CT2.1; machine: exponent arithmetic]. The unit-mass unit-lapse normalization ($m=1$, $N=1$, $w_i=0$) gives $\mathrm{KE}=\tfrac12\gamma^{ij}p_ip_j$. And $\gamma^{ij}\ne g^{ij}$ where the shift is nonzero: $g^{ij}=\gamma^{ij}-N^iN^j/N^2$ [machine] — the contraction that inverts the spatial momentum is $\gamma^{ij}$; the two coincide exactly in the shift-free gauge.

**Req.** D1.8, D2.1, D2.9 (Parts 1–2); CT1.12, CT2.1, CT2.6 (Part 2); P1, P5 (Parts 1–2); FT.157(1), FT.159 (Part 3); FT.44(4) (Census); BM.8(2), BM.10(1), BM.10(2), BM.10(6), BM.20(3) (this part); A §0.2a (the continuum-limit hypotheses at the point of use); Schur decomposition, adjugate calculus [math; machine: `checks/verify_H_kinetic_energy_metric.py` §A].

**Pf.**
$$\text{Definition block: the constitutive clauses are the displayed identities of}\ (2)\text{--}(5)\ [\text{machine: exact polynomial identities over}\ \mathbb Q[\Omega^2,\varkappa,\beta,w_i,q_{ij},p_\mu,m]\ \text{with denominators cleared by}\ \det\gamma];$$
$$\neg\exists\ \text{a non-derived clause: the ADM split is forced by the Schur decomposition of}\ g_{\mu\nu}\ [\text{math}];\qquad(1),(6)\ \text{are scope records}.\ \blacksquare$$

**Phys.** The energy of a moving sealed composite is read off the metric the corpus already derived, not added to it. The dictionary's ten sector coefficients split into lapse, shift, and spatial metric by linear algebra alone — the Schur decomposition of the very matrix CT1.12 builds — and the same three shift coefficients that the weak block carries enter the spatial momentum as its drag term. The mass-shell constraint of the Lorentzian metric converts these data into one exact dispersion identity, whose rest input is the informational mass the calibration tiers locked. Two normalizations — unit mass and coordinate time — are fixed as bookkeeping, and the read is chart-side: the register itself carries no canonical pair, and the definition keeps the obstruction exactly where Tier BM.4 placed it.

**Phys.** Motion enters the corpus through the metric the corpus already built. The dictionary's ten coefficients split into lapse, shift, and spatial metric by the Schur complement alone, and the mass-shell constraint of the Lorentzian metric turns that split into one exact identity: the energy conjugate to ledger time, corrected by the shift's drag, is the lapse times the square root of the rest mass squared plus the spatial momentum squared. In the vacuum gauge that is precisely the dispersion relation, and its expansion gives the kinetic energy with rational coefficients no one fitted — one half, minus one eighth, plus one sixteenth — nonnegative, vanishing only at zero momentum, wherever the dictionary's perturbative positivity holds. Two exact consequences deserve names. The width law converts the uncertainty bound at the Born width into a zero-point bound: a sealed composite spread over its own width carries at least seven quarters of its rest mass squared in energy squared — three eighths of the rest mass in the non-relativistic kinetic read, $\sqrt7/2$ times it in the exact relativistic one — every constant an exact rational over the ledger count. And the rest slice closes a triangle the corpus drew twice before: at zero momentum, the dispersion energy, the informational mass, and the curvature flux are one and the same monomial.

In the ultraviolet the Born envelope does the work: the composite is never a point, its width is strictly positive on every admissible cell, and the radial integral of the field square converges to an exact rational over that width. In the infrared the universe does the work: Gauss ties the asymptotic flux to the enclosed charge, and a valid universe encloses zero — so the total field's leading term cancels at scale, the residual multipoles fall as the cube, and the energy beyond any sphere is finite. The Lyapunov tower — the functional, its contraction, its deficit links, its inertial read — gives the neutron and the proton identical masses because it gives them identical inputs. **Rmk (what the refinement is).** The composite's rest input has always been the count of its internal directed edges, and the count is charge-blind to the last monomial. What the charge class does carry, and has always carried, is a filter on the transport register: twenty admissible end-sign assignments in the neutral class against fifteen in the charged one. The refinement takes the logarithm of that filter and books it where the corpus books every other entropy — against the vacuum, in the ledger's own currency, through the rest slot the dispersion read already reads. It is not a fourth mass route: it adds no functional of the flicker configurations, and it takes no ratio. It is the smallest entry the inventory supplies that is class-dependent, currency-matched, and alphabet-disjoint from the count.

### Def-BM.14 — The six-state assembly: the Platonic floors, the defect branches, and the generation map

**Def.** A census assembled from the Platonic card template $[\mathrm{Census\ FT.42}(5)]$, the duality degeneracy and the ledger splitting $[\mathrm{FT.44}(1)\text{--}(3)]$, the physical-card defect spectrum $[\mathrm{Census\ FT.63}(6)]$, and the $q$-channel triplet $[\mathrm{FT.119};\ \mathrm{Def\text{-}BM.6}(3)]$; no new axiom, no new datum, no new parameter, no external mass.
$$(1)\quad\textbf{the three mass floors:}\qquad m_{\mathrm{hid}}=\frac{2E\ln2}{\mathfrak h},\qquad2E\in\{12,\,24,\,24,\,60,\,60\}\ \ \text{over the five solids}\qquad[\mathrm{FT.42}(1),\ \text{card table}]:$$
$$\textbf{dual pairs are mass-degenerate and}\ \Pi\textbf{-degenerate at matched}\ K_S\ [\mathrm{FT.44}(1)]:\qquad\text{cube/octahedron}\ 24\ln2/\mathfrak h;\quad\text{dodecahedron/icosahedron}\ 60\ln2/\mathfrak h;\quad\text{tetrahedron self-dual}\ 12\ln2/\mathfrak h;$$
$$\boxed{\ \textbf{three mass values across the five solids}\ }\qquad\mathcal F:=\bigl\{\mathcal F_1{=}\{\text{tetrahedron}\},\ \ \mathcal F_2{=}\{\text{cube},\text{octahedron}\},\ \ \mathcal F_3{=}\{\text{dodecahedron},\text{icosahedron}\}\bigr\};$$
$$2E(\mathcal F_1){=}12\ <\ 2E(\mathcal F_2){=}24\ <\ 2E(\mathcal F_3){=}60,\qquad12:24:60=1:2:5\qquad[\text{machine: exact rationals, strictly increasing}];$$
$$(2)\quad\textbf{the branch on each floor (the derived 2):}\qquad\text{a floor's two members are distinguished by every finer ledger while sharing}\ m_{\mathrm{hid}}\ \text{and}\ \Pi\ [\mathrm{FT.44}(2)]:$$
$$\mathcal F_2,\ \mathcal F_3:\ \textbf{the duality branch}\ —\ \text{the dual exchanges}\ (V,F)\ \text{at fixed}\ E\ [\mathrm{FT.44}(1)];\qquad\mathcal F_1:\ \textbf{the weight-ladder branch}\ —\ \text{the tetrahedron is self-dual}\ [\mathrm{FT.44}(3)],\ \text{so its branch index is the ladder rung}\ m\in\{1,2\}\ [\mathrm{FT.60}(5);\ \mathrm{Census\ FT.63}(6)];$$
$$\textbf{the six states:}\qquad\mathcal S\ :=\ \{(\mathcal F_g,\beta):\ g\in\{1,2,3\},\ \beta\in\{-,+\}\},\qquad|\mathcal S|=3\cdot2=6\qquad[\text{machine}];$$
$$(3)\quad\textbf{the defect spectrum (the branch mass):}\qquad\delta_v=2\pi-d\,\frac{(L-2)\pi}L,\qquad D_S=4\sin^2\frac{\delta_v}4,\qquad m^2_{\mathrm{pole}}=\hat\mu'^2\,D_S\qquad[\mathrm{Census\ FT.63}(4),(6);\ \mathrm{Def\text{-}H.37}(2);\ \mathrm{FT.54}(4)]:$$

| state | $(\mathcal F_g,\beta)$ | $\delta_v/\pi$ | $D_S$ | exact field | min. polynomial of $D_S$ |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| $s_1$ | $(\mathcal F_1,-)$, the ladder rung $m{=}1$ | $1$ | $2$ | $\mathbb Q$ | $x-2$ |
| $s_2$ | $(\mathcal F_1,+)$, the ladder rung $m{=}2$ | $1$ | $4$ | $\mathbb Q$ | $x-4$ |
| $s_3$ | $(\mathcal F_2,-)$, the cube member | $\tfrac12$ | $2-\sqrt2$ | $\mathbb Q(\sqrt2)$ | $x^2-4x+2$ |
| $s_4$ | $(\mathcal F_2,+)$, the octahedron member | $\tfrac23$ | $1$ | $\mathbb Q$ | $x-1$ |

**Rmk (six states, no data).** Nothing in this definition is fitted. The floors come from the card template's edge counts; the branches come from the duality that leaves those counts fixed and splits everything finer; the branch masses come from the conical defect at a vertex where three faces meet, closed by Descartes against four pi. What the assembly adds is one order-isomorphism between two three-element ordered sets the corpus had already derived separately, and one name. The result is six states, six pairwise distinct exact algebraic masses on the defect species, three exact rationals on the informational one, and a hierarchy that runs one way in the bit currency and the other way in the angle currency — with the equation between the two currencies still open, and still not guessed.

**Phys.** The hypothesis was that the strong vertex, having two continuation symmetries against the electromagnetic vertex's one, would split the quark masses. The count is right: the Levi-Civita tensor is preserved by exactly the three even permutations of its slots, so the strong 3-vertex carries two nontrivial continuations, while the chain wall's single in-leg and single out-leg admit no nontrivial relabelling at all — its only candidate, the leg swap, reverses the end registers and is therefore the charge-conjugation involution, not a symmetry of the transport. The asymmetry is two by either counting convention. And it splits nothing. Three independent theorems kill it: the two baryon classes are the same vertex with the same phase class and the same edge count, so any vertex invariant is a common factor; the transported seed is annihilated by every colour generator, so the mass form has no slot index to differentiate; and on a sealed singlet every slot operator reads only its trace, which annihilates the doublet datum the continuation group acts on. What the asymmetry does buy is the family: the same $C_3$ that cannot split the neutron from the proton is what cycles a transport profile into three lines.

**Phys.** The intuition was that seeing the world through photons is not seeing it through colour, and that the difference should show up in the geometry. It does not. The emergent metric is built from the ambient ledger's coarse-grained sector coefficients, and not one of its seven derived monomials carries a charge exponent: the width, the volume, the density, the curvature scalar, the Schwarzschild-type read and both locks come out identical on the two classes to the last Laurent monomial. What a frame really is, in this corpus, is a mask — and the two masks have different grammars. Colour's is an idempotent that annihilates a sector at the first dangling attachment; electromagnetism's is a census that lets every local charge class through and cancels only once, at the scale of the whole universe. Masks filter operators and probability spaces. They do not re-read the metric. So the metric correction is exactly zero, and the frame's one surviving mass contribution is the scar's own field energy — positive, charge-selected, and on the wrong side: it makes the charged member heavier. That is the useful output. It narrows the search to a single column of the inventory, and the column has one entry.

**Phys.** Worked from both ends, the answer is the same object. From the mass side: whatever reverses the two rows has to be class-dependent, positive for the neutral class, dimensionally an energy through the rest slot, and built from data the edge count does not already carry — and the inventory has exactly one unbarred candidate. From the force side: colour is a projector that annihilates its own slot data on anything sealed, electromagnetism is a census that admits every local class, so the only class-dependent datum a sealed junction can carry is the count of admissible end-sign registers — twenty against fifteen. The candidate and the survivor are the same. Taken as a logarithm and booked against the vacuum in the ledger's own currency, the filter becomes an energy: the neutral class carries $\ln(4/3)$ more transport entropy than the charged one, and the neutral-core constituent carries exactly one bit more than the charged-core constituent. The reason the register counts as transport and not as bookkeeping is the parity lock: a chain whose ends agree can run wall-free, and a chain whose ends disagree cannot — the wall content of a constituent's transport is odd or even according to its charge core, so the multiplicity is a property of how the seed is carried, not of how the state is named. The sign is not a convention either. Of three possible references only one is a state the composite can be in, and it is the one the corpus already uses for every other deficit.

**Phys.** Six quarks fall out of three structures that were already sitting in the corpus in separate rooms. The three generations are the three lines of the colour channel, whose angle is one integer over three integers and whose orbit length is forced by the same $C_3$ that seals the baryon. The two members of each generation are a floor and its dual: two solids that share every edge count, hence every informational mass, and differ at every vertex figure — three squares meeting at right angles against four triangles meeting at one hundred twenty degrees, three pentagons against five triangles. Where duality is trivial, at the tetrahedron, the second branch is the weight ladder's own next rung. The mass of a branch is the conical defect at its vertex, and Descartes closes the ledger: five solids, each with its vertex defects summing to exactly four pi. The hierarchy comes out exact and comes out twice, in opposite directions. In the bit currency the floors climb one to two to five, strictly. In the angle currency they descend. That inversion is not a defect of the assembly; it is the same read-relativity the corpus already proved for the family lines, and the equation that would reconcile the two currencies is the one item the ledger still carries as open. Within a generation there is no ambiguity at all: the heavier branch is heavier by an exact algebraic number — two, root two minus one, two cosines of eighteen degrees minus root three — and it is heavier for the same reason in all three. Nothing was fitted, and nothing measured entered.

Nothing in the amended assembly contradicts the earlier one: the Lyapunov tower still shares every input, the geometry still carries no charge exponent, the binding still dies twice, and the scar's field energy is still counted exactly once. What is added is the transport register — twenty admissible end-sign assignments in the neutral class against fifteen in the charged one — read as an entropy in the ledger's own nats and booked through the same rest slot the field energy already uses. The two summands are commensurate, so the splitting becomes a single exact expression with a single exact zero: the critical strength is the logarithm of four thirds over six $c\ln2$, enclosed between one ninth and one seventh by four integer power comparisons, with the tighter of the two priced distributions clearing one ninth. Below that surface the neutron is heavier; above it the earlier order returns; on the surface the two rows are degenerate again. The corpus fixes no value for the coupling, so which branch it sits on is the one open row — and the branch that gives the world's order is not a thin one: it is an exact interval, certified by $256>243$, containing every coupling that keeps the field energy a correction rather than a competitor.

**Phys.** Making the neutron heavier does not open the decay, and the reason is a comparison of two exact integers. The transport refinement lifts the parent by at most the logarithm of four thirds — a fraction of one bit — while the cheapest possible charged daughter costs two bits of ledger content, and the neutral member costs nothing less than zero. Four against twelve: the excess cannot reach the floor, and the closure holds at every coupling on both sides of the critical surface, with an exact margin of one $\ln3$. Read at the level of a single chain, the refinement even helps the closure, because the neutral line is the one that carries the extra transport bit and the neutrino is the neutral member. So the tier reverses an ordering and leaves a verdict intact: the neutron becomes the heavier baryon on the sub-critical branch, and the beta vertex stays shut — not because the two rows are degenerate, which they are no longer, but because the gap between them is smaller than the lightest thing the decay could emit.

**Phys.** The tier's verdict in one sentence: both proposed mechanisms die exactly, and the one that survives was selected independently by the force structure and by the mass spectrum before either was told about the other. The vertex asymmetry is real — three continuations against one, an asymmetry of two by either counting convention — and it splits nothing, because the two baryon rows are the same vertex, because the transported seed is colour-blind, and because a sealed singlet reads only traces. The observation frame is real too — colour projects, electromagnetism censuses — and it splits nothing geometrically, because not one of the seven locked monomials carries a charge exponent; what it does produce is the scar's field energy, which points the wrong way. Between them they exhaust the force side and leave a single survivor in the inventory: the count of admissible end-sign registers, twenty against fifteen. Read as a logarithm against the vacuum, in the ledger's own nats, through the rest slot the field energy already uses, that census is an energy, and it is positive for the neutral class. The neutron becomes the heavier baryon on an exact branch of the coupling, bounded by four integer power comparisons, and the beta decay stays shut anyway — because the transport excess is a fraction of a bit and the cheapest daughter costs two. Six quark states come out of the same pass: three Platonic mass floors climbing one to two to five, each split into a lighter and a heavier branch by the conical defect at its own trivalent vertex, with the heavier branch heavier for the same exact reason in all three generations. And $\alpha_B$ is refused: not because the arithmetic is hard, but because there is no strong coupling to take as an argument, no count-to-strength theorem to build one from, and one exact charge-class number whose derivative in every coupling the corpus owns is zero.

**Phys.** Ask the ledger for a real holonomy and it answers in bits. The edge-phase register is binary, so every closed-loop product is plus or minus one, oriented either way; the wall content of any transport is parity-locked to its charge core, and at the composite the lock reads exactly — total wall parity equals the absolute charge modulo two, and the wall count bounds the charge from below. The winding and sealing registers are integers, and every integer winding contributes trivially to a phase, so their content is the rung, not an angle. Then the force decomposition is censused block by block at the sealed junction, and not one block carries a continuous vertex angle: the seals are finite and integer, the metric is charge-blind, the weak block is class-shared branch data, colour is annihilated by the trace law on anything sealed, electromagnetism is chart-side at a symbolic coupling, the dark blocks are uniform or locked, and the channel angles are line data attached to no baryon row. Any lift built from that material lands in the two-element subgroup — zero or pi — while the defect spectrum spreads six distinct values whose angles include a fifth of pi and a third of pi: four of the six states are provably out of reach, and the reachable sublattice is exactly the self-dual floor plus the ladder rungs whose defect value is zero, two or four. The winding route is shut separately, by calibration weight: the rung counts hops, the frame angle counts curvature, and no pure number bridges the two. So the tier records what it has — the binary Wilson sector, the parity lock, the integer sectors, the rung law — and issues the obstruction in structured form, with the missing enumeration named: the ledger realization of a loop that cleanly encloses one vertex. No angle is declared anywhere.

The assignment names the occupied ray left, matches it to the weak-active branch by a consistency census rather than a preference, and leaves the orientation involution to do what it always did — exchange the rays, reverse the winding, conjugate the vertex into its image. Spin resolves by ray without a single label invented: the winding rule stays a declared interface, the baryon card keeps its open rung, and helicity stays outside. The quark splitting stops floating: one of two possible gluings survives four frozen consistency rows, and the down-type constituent comes out heavier in the defect currency, the transport-register currency and the ensemble currency at once, with the electromagnetic correction the lone dissenter, dominated below its exact critical strength. The vertex becomes an operator — nilpotent, rank one, firing from the occupied ray alone — and the decay itself becomes allowed where the corpus said a specification act was the only door: on the specified read the Q-value is an exact rational minus two scale-weighted radicals, and the opening region, the closing region and the critical locus between them are all certified by integers. What did not move is named as loudly as what did: no currency was converted, no scale was fixed, no measured number entered, and every earlier verdict stands in its own species, rescoped in the open rather than quietly rewritten.

**Phys.** One law generates the whole Platonic mass spectrum: the cone defect at a vertex, read as an angle, squared into a mass by a single undeclared scale. Wind that angle by an integer and the ladder appears — periodic, even, monotone to a hard ceiling of four, with the tetrahedron degenerate at every weight and the even windings carrying an exactly massless middle rung. The dodecahedron is the deep row: its tower of Chebyshev polynomials closes at the fifth rung because the defining quartic of the eighteen-degree cosine *is* the statement that five times eighteen degrees is a right angle, so the heaviest weight of that solid sits at exactly two, forced by the same relation that makes its lightest weight the smallest positive defect angle in the census. The intra-generational ratios are then pure sines — one sine over another, at rational multiples of pi — and they come out as one, one, two, root three plus one, and a degree-eight number built from nested square roots of five. Their order is exact and their widest member is the dodecahedron's, in both winding conventions. Nothing here is a mass hierarchy in the channel sense: the widest ratio the entire Platonic ladder can supply at any winding is under seven, while the flattest family channel supplies over one hundred thirty-nine, and the two numbers are compared as arithmetic, never equated as physics — the range bar that deficit twelve records is re-certified with the census's own exact values, and the ceiling that bounds it is a theorem about angles, not about the world.

**Phys.** Three families, one polynomial. Every channel's mass-squared ratios are the three roots of the same cubic — four z cubed minus twenty-four z squared plus twenty-one minus twelve gamma, times z, minus gamma minus one squared — and the whole difference between the quark channel, the lepton channel and the neutrino channel is a single number: root two times the cosine of three times the channel's own angle. Those three numbers are exact, distinct, and ordered, and one identity ties two of them together: the lepton channel's heaviest line is precisely one more than the quark channel's cubic constant, because tripling the quark angle lands exactly on the lepton angle. The hierarchies then order themselves with no scale anywhere in the argument: below one twelfth of a turn the inner line shrinks, the middle line grows, and both ratios steepen monotonically, so the smallest angle gives the flattest family and the largest angle the steepest — quark, neutrino, lepton — with the lepton channel's inner line the closest to the exact zero at one twelfth of a turn, which is why its hierarchy is two orders of magnitude deep while the quark channel's is barely two. The brackets are exact rational intervals, not decimals: every digit the corpus froze in Part 3 is re-derived here from the angle alone and certified at widths far below the last quoted place. Nothing is fitted, no scale is fixed, and the ratios are what they always were — pure numbers waiting on three undeclared scales before they can be called masses.

**Phys.** Six states, two currencies, and not one proportionality between them. In the angle currency the six defect values are pairwise distinct algebraic numbers living in four fields, the heaviest branch on each floor is heavier by an exact amount, and those three amounts run strictly downward across the generations — two, root two minus one, and two cosines of eighteen degrees minus root three — so the splitting that separates a doublet is widest on the lightest floor and narrowest on the heaviest, the opposite of what a hierarchy reading would suggest. The doublet ratios themselves are pure sine ratios and their order is again not the generation order: the cube–octahedron pair is the tightest, the tetrahedral pair the middle, and the dodecahedron–icosahedron pair the widest by a degree-eight number whose norm is exactly one. In the bit currency the same six states collapse to three values climbing one to two to five. The two orders are opposite, and the tier proves something stronger than that they differ: no positive scale makes the floor ladder proportional to the channel ladder, because two is not three and a half and five is not one hundred thirty-nine; no scale makes the channel ladder proportional to the transport ladder, because one is quadratic in the channel cosine and the other affine and the quadratic coefficient is exactly two; and the transport ladder inverts against both. The generation map survives all of this as what it always was — the unique order-isomorphism between two three-element ordered sets — and it supplies an order, never a number.

**Phys.** The neutron–proton mass ratio is one exact expression: the logarithm of one thousand two hundred eighty over the logarithm of nine hundred sixty plus a nonnegative multiple of the logarithm of two. Everything about it follows by arithmetic in the ring generated by the logarithms of the primes. It decreases strictly with the coupling, so its largest value is the coupling-free one, and that value sits between twenty-six twenty-fifths and twenty-one twentieths — an exact upper bound of one and one twentieth on the ratio, valid at every coupling the corpus admits. It is irrational at every rational coupling, by unique factorization of two, three and five inside the logarithms, and it equals one at exactly one coupling, which is two minus the base-two logarithm of three and is therefore irrational too: the degenerate point of the trichotomy is provably not a rational coupling, and at every rational coupling the two baryons differ. The critical strength inherits the same irrationality and the same four integer certificates that enclose it between a ninth and a seventh, so the opening region is a wide exact interval, not a tuned point, and the closing region is inhabited by anything above a sixth. The bridge term contributes nothing here and cannot: it lives in the angle currency, it points the same way, and adding it to a bit count is the one operation the ledger forbids. No measured ratio enters, no external value is compared, and the single open datum — the numerical value of the electric coupling — is the same one the corpus has named at every tier, deciding which side of the critical surface the world sits on without ever being supplied.

**Phys.** The corpus never had a charged ball. It had an integer read on the ends of chains, a width derived from an edge count, and a field equation varied from an action it already owned. Asking whether the charge sits on a shell or fills a ball asks for a density the graph cannot supply: the end signs carry no positions, so there is nothing to smear and nothing to integrate over the interior. That single observation disposes of the priced coefficient and, at the same time, rescues the number that mattered — because the exterior field of a sealed charge is fixed by Gauss alone, and the potential route needs nothing but the potential at one radius. Both give exactly one half, twice, with no distribution in either argument. So the self-energy keeps its shape, its selector, its sign and its dimension, loses a classical artifact, and gains a locus: it is now an average over the flicker ensemble, which is where the composite actually lives once the threshold is nonzero. The interior multipole content stays open exactly where the earlier audit left it, named and unfilled, and every downstream row is re-scoped rather than erased — the chart-side numbers stand as the fully crystallized, vacuum-gauge specialization of a formula that now carries two derived factors the chart could not see.

**Phys.** A coupling with no scale at which to sit is not a number, and the corpus never pretended otherwise: it fixed the combination of the two gauge strengths and left the value open. What it can do is say how the coupling's *profile* runs, and every ingredient of that profile is already derived. Distance enters through the only length the ledger owns — the Born width, which is the reciprocal of an edge count — and through the fraction of an inverse-square flux enclosed within a given number of those widths, which is one minus one over k, exactly. Time enters through the lapse of the emergent metric, which is one in the vacuum gauge and departs from one only where the shift and the conformal coefficient do. Curvature enters through the one dimensionless monomial the calibration lock supplies: the Born width squared times the Ricci scale, equal to two pi times the square of the edge count times the logarithm of two, free of h, free of the cosmological term, free of every declared parameter. Multiply the three and the coupling is an exact algebraic function of position, energy and lapse — vanishing at the member's own envelope, growing without bound toward its far-field value, never quite reaching it at any finite radius. The composition of the curvature factor is not derived, because nothing in the inventory turns a count into a strength, so it is priced three ways and adopted not at all. The running comes out in the direction a loop calculation would give it, from geometry alone, with no loop in the argument and no number fitted anywhere.

Declaring a defect-dependent rate would be exactly the kind of parameter this part has refused eleven times over, and it is refused again: the calibration registry stays empty, and the two currencies stay as incommensurate as the item that names them.

**Phys.** Put the corrected field energy into the splitting and almost nothing moves — which is the point. Both classes lose the same fraction of their edge register to the flicker, so the crystallization weight cancels out of the ledger difference entirely and survives only where the field lives: the electromagnetic term is now the shell value, times the lapse, times the crystallization weight, times the curvature composition, times three times the logarithm of two over h. The critical strength inherits those three factors in the denominator, which means the opening region can only widen as the composite fails to crystallize, and in the fully dissolved limit it never closes at all. Better, the bar becomes parameter-free in the ensemble data: whenever the product of lapse, weight, curvature composition and coupling stays at or below one eighth, the neutron is the heavier baryon, and the certificate is a single pair of integers, eight thousand one hundred ninety-two against six thousand five hundred sixty-one. The ratio itself is bounded between one and ten ninths at every admissible value of everything the corpus declines to fix, with the old one-and-a-twentieth bound recovered as the fully crystallized endpoint and the logarithm of twenty over the logarithm of fifteen as the dissolved supremum. And the incommensurability hardens: the coupling at which the informational ratio would equal the ensemble's four thirds is negative for every crystallization weight in the admissible range, on the single integer certificate that sixty-four is less than four hundred five.

But the accusation cost nothing that mattered, because the same value falls out twice without a distribution — once from the flux outside the envelope, which Gauss fixes from the total charge alone, and once from the potential at a single radius, which needs no volume at all. Both say one half. So the coefficient the corpus had priced twice and adopted never is now derived once, and the interior term that needed a density is named as a residue instead of being guessed. What replaces the classical integral is an average over the flicker ensemble, and the average brings three exact dimensionless companions: the lapse of the emergent metric, the nearby-space fraction one minus one over k, and the calibration lock's curvature monomial, which is two pi times the square of the edge count times the logarithm of two and carries no h, no cosmological term and no declared parameter. The coupling runs with all three, vanishes at the member's own envelope, and grows with energy for purely geometric reasons. The splitting that results is the old one with three symbols in its electromagnetic term, its critical strength pushed outward by every failure to crystallize, its ratio bounded by ten ninths at every admissible value of everything, and its trichotomy intact. The decay stays closed where a read closes it and open where a read opens it, and the one thing both reads still agree on is which baryon decays.

**Phys.** The composite was never a snapshot, and the count that was read as one is a single point of an exact distribution. Take the flicker's own measure — the unique stationary line of the Janus generator, three pairs each retained with weight one minus four thresholds — and the internal count takes the values zero, two, four and six with the binomial weights, its unconditioned mean six times that weight and its variance twelve times the weight times its complement. The zero is not a composite: an all-virtual configuration supports no closed chain and therefore no terminus, and it is exactly the vacuum the entropy argument and the Lyapunov contraction both run toward, so the composite's read is the conditional one on at least two edges, and that restriction is a theorem of the materialization domain rather than a choice of scope. Conditional on it, the mean count is six over one plus u plus u squared, which never leaves the interval from two to six: the crystallized count at the top, attained only at the sharp threshold, and the digon's two at the bottom, attained only in the fully dissolved limit. The relative width of the distribution has an exact algebraic maximum, ten plus seven root seven over one hundred sixty-two, reached at a stationary point in the same quadratic field, and it is bounded by a fifth — so the informational mass fluctuates, but never by more than half of itself. The reciprocal register splits into two formed reads whose product is at least one by Cauchy–Schwarz and below six fifths by an exact quartic positivity, so the Born width has a width-of-the-mean and a mean-of-the-widths, and the difference is named rather than guessed. Read A took the top point for the whole distribution; the weight it ignored is three u over D, exactly, and it is positive at every threshold that lets the vertex fire at all.

**Phys.** Ask which state a constituent occupies at a vertex and the ledger answers with a list, not a value. A neutral-core constituent carries two transport realizations and a charged one carries a single realization, so the class fibre is a weighted set: at charge zero one triple of weight eight against six of weight two, summing to twenty; at charge one three of weight four against three of weight one, summing to fifteen. Normalize and the superposition is exact — two fifths on the all-neutral triple, a tenth on each of the six mixed ones — and the numbers are rationals in an alphabet that carries no coupling at all, which is the coupling-blindness theorem wearing a different hat. The class entropy then splits cleanly into the Shannon entropy of that superposition plus the mean logarithm of the multiplicities, and the baryon's transport splitting, the log of four thirds, is the sum of two strictly positive parts: nine fifths of a bit less the log of three, from the superposition, and one fifth of a bit, from the multiplicities. A read that fixes one triple at the vertex books no entropy and forfeits the larger part of the splitting, so the fixed-state read is not merely incomplete, it is quantitatively short by an exact prime-log element. The two registers stay independent — the fibre weights are boundary data and the edge count has no endpoint summand — so the baryon's ledger read is the composition of two exact averages, and no equation between the registers is formed. The sharpest row is the bound: no single vertex configuration carries more than two fifths of the neutral class's transport weight, certified by sixteen against twenty.

**Phys.** The neutral line the vertex emits is a rung-one seal, and everything about it that the corpus can derive, it derives. Its channel angle is two over sixteen, the undressed seal coefficient over the mask dimension the complete-force rule already fixed; its rest mass is the transport defect evaluated on that angle, three exact values in a radical ring, ordered heaviest to lightest against the spectral order by the same inversion the family mass form proves in general. Every one of the three is strictly positive, squeezed between two sums of squares that never touch zero, and the kernel line that would make one of them massless is unreachable by an exact trigonometric census — so there is no massless option to decline and no zero to explain away. The absolute scale stays undeclared, as every scale in this part does, and the internal ratios stay derived. On the carrier the line occupies one ray and its complement is empty: not heavy, not suppressed, empty, because a dissolution-first history is outside the transition domains and unregistered content supports no accessible pole at any rung. The image orientation the vertex selects is the mirror of that same single-arrow locus, one orbit of size two carrying no datum of its own. Four separate bars then close the door on any seesaw-type mechanism — no partner state, no self-pairing, no coupling object, no second scale — and the smallness of the line is left where the corpus has always left it, with the free internal data. The two states of the line are the vacuum-resident balanced pair and the materialized seal, and the only door between them is the vertex, whose weight vanishes exactly at the sharp threshold: the line materializes only where the flicker is present, which is the same threshold the ensemble integral is taken over.

Count the edges and it is the single undeclared packaging times the state's defect factor over four times the count squared. Read the count through the calibration lock and the same object is pi log two over two times the packaging times the defect factor over the curvature monomial — the bridge is inversely proportional to the lock, with the coefficient exact. Read the count through the envelope ratio and it becomes mu-prime squared times the defect factor times the radius squared over four, times the square of one minus the nearby-space fraction; substitute the coupling's own profile and the bridge is an exact function of the running coupling, strictly decreasing in it at fixed geometry, so the energy-dependence of the bridge is literally the energy-dependence of the coupling and nothing else. Put the flicker in and every form gains one factor: the bridge is multiplied by the square of the dilution denominator, which is bounded by an exact integer nine, attained only in a limit that is not a materialized universe, and equal to one exactly at the sharp threshold where the snapshot returns. The curvature lock rides between two computed cells, the digon's and the junction's own, and the coupling's zero is confined to within a factor of three of the crystallized width. Everything in those four forms is derived exact algebra — one number is not, and the four grounds that bar its derivation stand where they were proved.
