**Phys.** Filter the ensemble to the configurations that can carry a composite and three rows change shape. The assembly keeps its form — six times the weight times log two, plus the class's own transport entropy, less the electromagnetic term — but the weight is now one over one plus u plus u squared, and it cannot fall below a third. That single bound does real work. The critical coupling is squeezed into an exact window between two fifteenths and five twelfths over the lapse and the curvature composition, and the two bars that decide the sign of the splitting lose the crystallization weight entirely: an eighth or less of the coupling product forces the neutron heavier, five twelfths or more forces it lighter, and the undecided band between them is exact and inhabited. The ratio bound tightens from ten ninths to the log of eighty over the log of sixty, itself enclosed between sixteen fifteenths and fifteen fourteenths by two integer power certificates, and the Q-value's ratio form tightens from a third to a quarter by eighty-one against eighty. The dissolution row is rescoped rather than retracted: at the far end of the threshold range the unconditioned ensemble piles its weight onto the empty configuration, which supports no chain and no terminus, so that limit is not a materialized universe at all — and inside the materialization domain the splitting can always be closed by a finite coupling. Nothing measured entered: the ratio is derived from the filter and the prime-log assembly, the coupling stays symbolic, and the closure of the decay on the informational currency survives the filter exactly as it survived the ensemble.

**Phys.** Four acts, one ledger. The snapshot read is replaced by an integral over an exact distribution whose materialized mean cannot fall below the digon's two edges and whose relative width cannot exceed a half; the weight that prices the failure to crystallize is now bounded below by a third, and that one bound converts a weight-dependent inequality into a two-sided bar with no parameter in it at all. The Q-value moves onto the rest masses, which in this corpus means the pole masses, and the move turns out to be free of consequences for the flicker, because the specified read's alphabet contains no edge count and no threshold — the two acts are orthogonal, and every witness the specification certified still certifies. The neutral line occupies a single ray, is strictly massive in form from a derived channel angle, and cannot be given a partner: four independent bars, each a theorem of an earlier tier, close every route to a seesaw-type mechanism, and the smallness of the line stays a question about undeclared scale rather than an invitation to invent one. The relating equation is derived in four forms — count, curvature, coupling, flicker-weighted — with its enhancement bounded by an exact nine and its curvature argument confined between two computed cells, and it closes in the only sense this corpus allows: the equation is a theorem and its one undeclared number remains undeclared, with four grounds standing against deriving it. The cost is one named residue and one marked specialization. Nothing was declared, nothing was fitted, and nothing measured entered anywhere.

## Tier BM.20 — Six Objective Resolutions: the Energy-Scale Graph, the Dimensional Bridge, the Eigenvalue Composition, the Curvature Composition, the General Crystallization Weight, and the Kind Structure of the Arrow

**Locus.** This tier takes six named objectives and gives each its exact adjudication: one graph, one census with one declared slot, one referent table, one fixed point, one measure-free bound, and one kind structure. The Q-value becomes a function of the energy scale, its forward and inverse reads are shown to be one graph reflected, and its crossing is a derived strength enclosed by two integers — with the crossing *count* depending on the priced curvature composition ($\mathrm{BM.101}$). The dimension surface is censused against the single information flux, the seven rows are derived or adjudicated, and the two bridges are separated: the dimensional one is $\mathfrak h$, the numerical one is $\rho_{\mathrm B}$, whose status is declared as the §II.4 addendum A-BM.9 with no value issued ($\mathrm{BM.102}$). The three-constituent assembly's eigenvalue equations are derived where they are formed — the family cubic and the binomial characteristic polynomial — and the tensor-product referent is censured where it is not, so the composition question and the octet question are both adjudicated $\neg$formed ($\mathrm{BM.103}$). The curvature composition's self-consistency condition is formed exactly, solved for all three priced candidates, and shown to select none, because the lock's own freedom census excludes the back-reaction ($\mathrm{BM.104}$). The crystallization weight is derived measure-free and for an arbitrary threshold family, with the same exact bounds, and the defect-conditioned version is refuted ($\mathrm{BM.105}$). The spin label and the tick arrow are derived, and the exchange structure that a statistics requires is censured: deficit 11 stands with its residue named ($\mathrm{BM.106}$). $\mathrm{BM.107}$ adjudicates.

**Standing rows.** $\alpha_B$ stays barred on $\mathrm{BM.61}(8)$'s four grounds. No clause of $\mathrm{BM.1}$–$\mathrm{BM.100}$ is retracted, replaced or renumbered: every row this tier touches is re-scoped at its own locus and recorded in $\mathrm{BM.101}(8)$, $\mathrm{BM.104}(8)$, $\mathrm{BM.105}(7)$ and $\mathrm{BM.107}(5)$, in $\mathrm{BM.77}(7)$'s pattern. No measured coupling, mass or ratio enters any derivation $[\mathrm{P5}]$: the crossing strength of $\mathrm{BM.101}(3)$ is a derived symbolic value and is $\neg$compared to any external number; the neutron–proton ratio stays derived and bounded $[\mathrm{BM.99}(5)]$. No right-ray matter line and no seesaw-type mechanism is suggested, added or required $[\mathrm{BM.96}(4),(6)\ \text{re-cited},\ \neg\text{extended}]$; $\neg$an external mixing matrix is imported — the mixing rows are reads of the derived $16$-arena $[\mathrm{FT.142}(2),(5);\ \mathrm{FT.145}(3)]$. One dimension only: units are powers of $\mathfrak q$ $[\mathrm{D2.9};\ \mathrm{CT2.1}]$. Local notation, fixed for the whole tier: $E_1:=\mathfrak h/(r\ln2)$ the envelope-unit count; $x:=E/E_1=k$ the scale ratio $[\mathrm{BM.88}(2)(\mathrm i)]$; $\beta:=2\pi\ln2\,E_1^2=2\pi\mathfrak h^2/(r^2\ln2)\in\mathfrak q^0$; $f=1-\tfrac1x$; $G=\beta x^2$; $\varepsilon_{\mathrm{eff}}:=Nf\,\mathsf g\,\varepsilon_{\mathrm{EM}}=e(r,E,N)^2/(4\pi)$; $\varepsilon_\ast(w)$ the crossing strength; $c:=\varepsilon_\ast/(N\varepsilon_{\mathrm{EM}})$; $a:=\tfrac12Nw\,\varepsilon_{\mathrm{EM}}Q^2$; $p_i,u_i,R,S$ the family data of $\mathrm{BM.105}(3)$; $[\cdot]$ the $\mathfrak q$-exponent map $[\mathrm{CT2.1};\ \mathrm{D2.9}]$. **Phys.** One graph, read twice. The forward and inverse Q-values are exact negatives, so the two reactions the question asks about are one curve and its reflection, and the boundary between them is a single level set of the derived coupling profile. On the informational currency the curve never changes sign: the two-bit floor on the emitted lines keeps the forward channel closed and the inverse channel open at every scale, with the exact margin log three, so the only sign structure the graph carries is the splitting's. That structure is decided by one derived number, the crossing strength — log of four thirds over three weights times log two, which is two minus the binary logarithm of three over three weights — enclosed between an eighth and five twelfths by the same two integer powers that give the parameter-free bar. The bar and the crossing are the same statement: below the lower end the curve never crosses at any scale, above the upper end it always does, and inside the band the flicker weight alone decides. The profile's own shape then does the rest. With the flat composition the crossing is a closed form, one over one minus c; with the growing composition there is exactly one crossing at every positive coupling, because the profile diverges; with the decreasing composition the profile is a window — it rises from zero, peaks at the unique root of an exact cubic, and returns to zero, so the forward channel opens at one scale and closes at another, or never opens, and the peak has the closed form one minus three over twice the root, sitting below a quarter whenever the radius parameter exceeds a quarter. Two compositions give a half-line, one gives a window, and the corpus still cannot say which is its own. What is exact and free of every undeclared datum is the crossing value; what needs the one open calibration number is where in radius and energy that value is reached.

**Phys.** The corpus has one dimension and this tier counts with it. Length and time are the same power, mass and energy the same power, density and stress-energy two powers up, curvature one, and the single free scale sits at minus one half — so every balance in the census is an integer sum, and the seven rows of the question come out derived where the inventory has a referent and adjudicated where it does not. Temperature is a dimension row and nothing more, because no thermal parameter exists; amount of substance is a count; and electric current has two reads that are not equated, the ledger's weight per tick at exponent zero and the chart's density at three halves, the latter forced by the field equation and the field-energy row. The bridge the question asks about turns out to be two bridges. The dimensional one is the free scale itself: it takes a count of bits to a mass, and it was declared at the outset with no value ever issued. The numerical one is dimensionless, so it converts no dimension at all — it is the exchange rate between the ledger's bit currency and the holonomy's angle currency, and it is the single number the relating equation needs. That number is now declared: one slot in the era's calibration registry, logged before use, packaging two data that were already declared elsewhere, adding no parameter and no scale, and carrying no value. With it supplied, every cross-currency ratio in the corpus becomes an exact algebraic number state by state; without it, nothing is lost, because the four grounds against deriving it stand and no summand crosses between the two currencies. The equation is closed; the number is a calibration act the corpus prices and does not perform.

**Phys.** Ask the chart for the spectrum of a three-quark object and the honest answer is a table of what exists and what does not. What exists is two eigenvalue equations, and neither is the one the question wants. The first is the family cubic: four z cubed minus twenty-four z squared plus a channel constant, whose three roots are the three lines of a channel, with a phase-free sum of six and an exact product — a spectrum of generations, not of constituents. The second is the transport assembly's own characteristic polynomial, which collapses to a binomial: two plus z plus one over z, cubed, is z plus one to the sixth over z cubed, so the seven class weights are the binomial coefficients of six, and the assembly's spectrum is a single root of multiplicity six, one per directed edge. That is charge-class data, and it is the deepest eigenvalue statement the chart supports. What does not exist is the object the question names: a three-constituent state space, an exchange operator, a flavour index, a triple-level resolution — the counting spaces the corpus declares have no state on them, and the twenty-seven-dimensional candidate was rejected as an arena at rung one. So the determinant is not formed, and the two triples the question asks about are neither formed nor excluded; the composition is unread, and that is a named residue rather than an oversight. What is derived instead is sharper: the seal grammar forces exactly three, the charge balance forces their sum, the binomial forces the seven classes and the four-thirds lead of the neutral one, and the stability question lands where the corpus has always landed — on an undeclared spectral filter and a refuted index-zero route. The octet is not derivable either: the three here is colour's, the eight is a capacity ratio barred as a coupling, the ten is a grammar count, and the flavour symmetry that does exist is cyclic of order three.

**Phys.** The weight that prices a composite's failure to crystallize does not need the specialization that first produced it. Linearity alone gives it as the mean fraction of the three pairs that are real, and the materialization restriction alone gives its bounds: at least one pair is real, at most three are, so the weight lives between a third and one for every measure the ensemble could carry, with both endpoints characterized exactly — a third when only single pairs materialize, one when the full configuration does. That is a stronger statement than the specialization's, and it is why the mean edge count can never fall below the digon's two. Then the family: let each of the three pairs carry its own threshold, still inside the derived admissible range, and the weight becomes the sum of the three retention probabilities over three times one minus their product, with seven materialized configurations, exact second moments, and an arithmetic-mean-geometric-mean row that pins it below one with equality only when every pair is crystallized. Set the three equal and the whole of the previous tier's formula returns identically. What the family does not license is the version the question asks for: six thresholds, one per quark state, each a function of that state's defect value. That is the branch-conditioned weighting already refuted — the measure's alphabet holds one symbol and the defect values' holds two, four separate grounds bar any count-to-strength map, six thresholds would be six declared parameters, and the axiom's threshold carries no state argument. So the weight stays branch-blind, the six defect values stay in the pole currency, and the residue narrows rather than closes: what is left is the correlation between pairs, named and priced, and the transport register's own ensemble average.

**Phys.** The corpus can name the spin and it can name the arrow, and it cannot join them, for a reason that is structural rather than temporary. The spin label comes from the winding: half the winding number, with the Casimir ladder and the weight multiplet behind it, and at the floor the winding is the registration integer of the two-cycle, so the same kind of object carries spin one half at one value of that integer and spin one at the next. There is therefore no parity theorem to be had: the floor itself supplies both parities on materialized closed bound chains, all of one definitional kind. The arrow is just as concrete — no inverse tick, a ledger that never shrinks, a prefix law that makes dissolution presuppose crystallization, a Lyapunov function that contracts by nine sixteenths per step at unit tilt — and the occupancy it forces is one ray full and the other empty. What is missing is not a step from arrow to sign but the object the sign would act on: there is no two-chain state space, no exchange operator, no permutation representation, and the corpus has already ruled that identifying a single-object grade with a permutation sign is a confusion of kinds. So the connection is not derived, and deficit eleven stands with its residue now named: an exchange structure, three ingredients, none of them in the inventory. What the tier adds is the census that makes the absence exact, the four gradings shown to be single-object and exhaustively so, and the location of the only antisymmetry the corpus does have — the colour seal's epsilon, which is unobservable by construction, against a transport assembly whose seven weights are all positive and an amplitude layer whose signs are barred as masses. The mixing rows stay where the arena puts them: sixteen dimensions, one eighth, and no imported matrix.

**Phys.** Six objectives came in and six verdicts went out, and only one of them is a plain yes. The graph is the yes: the two reactions are one curve reflected, the crossing strength is a derived number enclosed between an eighth and five twelfths by two integer powers, and the curve's shape — a half-line, an always-crossing half-line, or a window that opens and shuts — is decided by which curvature composition the corpus is eventually given, so the unresolved choice has an observable consequence inside the theory even though nothing here can make it. The dimension count is a yes with a correction: one flux, seven rows derived or adjudicated, and two bridges where the question assumed one, because the scale that carries bits to mass is the free scale and the number that exchanges bits for angles is dimensionless. That number is now declared, as a slot with no value in it, which closes the relating equation as an equation and leaves the calibration where the corpus leaves every calibration. The other three objectives are exact negatives with content. There is no three-quark matrix to take eigenvalues of, because there is no state space, no exchange operator and no flavour index — but there are two eigenvalue equations that do exist, a family cubic summing to six and a binomial whose single root has multiplicity six, one per directed edge. The curvature composition solves its own consistency condition three times over and is selected by none of them, and the back-reaction that would have selected it is excluded by the lock's own freedom census. The crystallization weight generalizes past its specialization: measure-free bounds with both equality loci, a threshold family with seven exact configuration weights, and a refutation of the six-state version on the four old grounds. And spin meets statistics at a wall the corpus has already mapped — the spin label is derived, the arrow is derived, and at the floor the same kind of chain carries both parities, so what is missing is not a step but an exchange structure, now named. **Phys.** Of the three reversals the corpus derives, two run and one does not. Charge conjugation and parity are maps the ledger can apply to a configuration; time reversal is a map it can apply to a record but never to a step, because the tick has no inverse, the ledger only grows, and the Lyapunov function only contracts — at sharp crystallization by exactly seven sixteenths per tilt. Composing the two that run gives the conjugation that matters, and its action is exact and cheap: the charge read flips, the scar flips, the chiral rays exchange, the triplet attachment becomes a dual one, the weight picks up a fourth root of unity that is exactly one on the sealed junction's own phase class, and the seven geometric reads do not move at all, because not one of them carries a charge exponent. So the conjugate is mass-degenerate with the original by structure rather than by luck. That it must exist is not an addition but a consequence: total charge vanishes in every valid universe, a charged chain therefore needs a compensator, the alphabet contains exactly one value that compensates it, and of the derived maps exactly one produces a configuration carrying that value with a dual attachment, the opposite ray, and the same edge count. The orbit census is the same statement at the level of classes — one self-conjugate neutral class, every charged class exchanged, one fixed charge tuple at every level and equal weights on the two charged classes. The structural parallel is then exact in its own terms: a balance, a forward-only order, and a fixed sixteen-dimensional arena leave one derived compensator, which is the shape of the argument that forces a conjugate branch, and the tier says no more than that — no Dirac operator, no spinor, no annihilation channel, and no name outside the identification layer.

**Phys.** A pair made of a chain and its conjugate is neutral because the conjugate's charge is the negative of the chain's, and it is mass-degenerate because none of the seven geometric reads carries a charge exponent and the defect read is branch data rather than charge data. Its informational mass is exactly twice a member's and its width exactly half, with the count-route binding identically zero — a binding energy cannot be an integer summation, and the pair is the cleanest case of it. The weight for making one is not declared: it is the Janus resolvent's own $x_+x_-$, a parabola in the single crystallization threshold with maximum one quarter at one eighth and zeros at both ends of the admissible range. So the ledger creates pairs exactly where it flickers, and nowhere else — at the sharp threshold the dissolution weight vanishes, no pair is made, and nothing decays. What the tier does not give the pair is a fate: no annihilation channel and no inter-sector cross-section exist in the inventory, and the pair stays one orbit of size two carrying no datum its member does not.

**Rmk (why this is a construction and not a declaration).** Every ingredient is derived and frozen: the orientation doublet and its involution from the fermion era's interface layer, the winding carrier and its dimension from the multiplicity–winding coupling, the inner product from the norm layer, the flip from the pair axiom's own $S^2=\mathbb1$, and the transport phase from the CP character. **Phys.** The corpus said for three tiers that a statistics has no referent, and listed exactly what one would need: a space of two chains, an operator that swaps them, and a sign to read off. This definition supplies all three and nothing more. The space is the tensor product of the two single-chain spaces the fermion era already built — the orientation doublet and the winding carrier — so it has an inner product from the norm layer, a finite exact dimension of four times the two carrier dimensions, and it is a state space rather than a counting space, which is the bar the species definitions set. The swap is the canonical flip, whose square is one because the pair axiom already said so, composed with the one phase the CP-identification forces: transporting a chain to its conjugate's slot multiplies by the fourth root of unity the CPT bridge derived. The sign is that phase evaluated on the symmetric sector, and on the materialized locus it is a genuine plus or minus. What remains open is the obvious next step and the definition says so: three chains, and the permutation group that acts on them, are not built here.

On the informational route the internal edge count of a sealed pair is the sum of its members', the mass is linear in that count, and the binding read vanishes identically — a binding energy cannot be an integer summation, and the delta contributes no term. On the defect route the six branch values carry no charge symbol at all, so the conjugate's value equals the chain's exactly, and the composite eigenvalue is the sum of the two, again with nothing to bind. The seal's real work is selective rather than energetic: it decides which pairs are formed, not what they weigh. The third route, the ensemble average, is honestly absent — the frozen sector masses were computed at the three-chain junction and no two-chain sector mass exists in the corpus, so the meson's ensemble binding is named as a new residue and left unfilled. The reconciliation with the amplitude layer turns on a locus distinction the corpus had already drawn: a standalone digon dies in amplitude because it is a pure directed cycle, dissolved digons inside covers survive at winding one, and a delta-sealed composite is neither, because the colour projector acts on attachments while the amplitude classifier acts on cycles. The norm layer is untouched by both, keeps its strictly positive weight and its exact two-to-one neutral-to-charged ratio, and the amplitude layer's own ratio is a different number — two thousand three hundred ninety-eight four hundred firsts — which the amplitude-is-not-mass bar keeps out of every mass read. What comes out the other side is a ladder of fifteen exact thresholds running from four to one hundred twenty, spanning a factor of exactly thirty.

**Phys.** The swap has a phase alphabet and it is the fourth roots of unity, because every edge phase is a sign times a power of $i$: the alignment takes two values and the line element takes half-integers. The CP transport multiplies by $e^{i\pi\Theta}$, and on the materialized locus the winding is an even integer, so that phase is exactly one while its half-turn $i^\Theta$ is exactly $(-1)^k$. That is the whole mechanism. The exchange sign is the winding's parity; the spin label is half the winding; so the exchange sign is $(-1)^{2j}$, plus one for integer spin and minus one for half-integer spin, and the connection is a theorem with a two-line induction certificate behind it. It does not contradict the earlier refutation, and the tier is explicit about why: what was refuted was a spin-parity theorem on the bound-or-transit kind, and both parities do occur on one kind at the floor, because the statistics depends on the winding and not on the kind, nor on the registration datum. The one thing that is chosen rather than derived is which sector of the two-chain space the sign is read on, and the tier prices the choice: the symmetric and antisymmetric sectors give the same statistics up to a global sign, while the determinant line and the orientation block give different answers or none, so the read is stated with its locus attached. What is not used is any of the three classical routes — no Lorentz covariance, no positivity of energy, no microcausality — and deficit eleven closes on the phase alphabet and the additivity of the winding, with the residue the previous tier named now discharged at two chains and the three-chain space left open where it was.

### Def-BM.17 — The local resonance and its two threshold functions

**Def.** A resonance $:=$ an eigenvalue of a multi-chain ensemble together with its two derived local functions. A construction on $\mathrm{Def\text{-}BM.14}$'s six-state assembly, $\mathrm{BM.13}$'s width ladder, $\mathrm{BM.34}$'s ADM split, $\mathrm{BM.44}$'s per-tick weight and $\mathrm{BM.88}$'s coupling profile; no new axiom, no new datum, no new parameter, no cosmological coordinate.

$$(1)\quad\textbf{the resonance tuple:}\qquad\boxed{\ \mathcal R\ :=\ \bigl(n,\ \sigma,\ Q,\ \mathbf s,\ k\bigr)\ }$$
$$n\in\{1,2,3\}\ \ \text{the chain count}\ [\mathrm{CT3.17a}(1):\ \text{a sealed support partitions into}\ 2\text{'s and}\ 3\text{'s}];\qquad\sigma\in\{\delta,\varepsilon\}\ \ \text{the junction grammar}\ [\mathrm{D3.9};\ \mathrm{Def\text{-}BM.1}];$$
$$Q\in\{-n,\dots,+n\}\ \ \text{the charge class}\ [\mathrm{Def\text{-}BM.8}(1);\ \mathrm{BM.103}(5)];\qquad\mathbf s=(s_1,\dots,s_n)\in\mathcal S^n\ \ \text{the constituent states}\ [\mathrm{Def\text{-}BM.14}(2):\ |\mathcal S|=6];$$
$$k\in\mathbb Z_{\ge0}\ \ \text{the winding}\ [\mathrm{FT.22};\ \mathrm{Def\text{-}H.38}];\qquad\textbf{constitutive clause:}\ \ \text{the tuple is derived structural data}\ [\mathrm{Def\text{-}BM.2}\ \text{pattern}];\qquad\textbf{no entry is a species name}\ [\mathrm{Def\text{-}BM.3}(7)];$$
$$(2)\quad\textbf{the internal count and the informational mass:}\qquad E_{\mathrm{int}}(\mathcal R)=\sum_{a=1}^{n}E_{\mathrm{int}}(s_a),\qquad E_{\mathrm{int}}(s)\in\{2,\ 6,\ 12,\ 24,\ 60\}\ \ \text{on the computed cells}\qquad[\mathrm{D0.8};\ \mathrm{BM.13}(2);\ \mathrm{FT.28};\ \text{Census FT.35}(2),\ \text{FT.42}(5)\ \text{row-wise}]:$$
$$m_{\mathrm{hid}}(\mathcal R)=\frac{E_{\mathrm{int}}(\mathcal R)\ln2}{\mathfrak h}\qquad[\mathrm{FT.44}(4)];\qquad m^2_{\mathrm{pole}}(\mathcal R)=\hat\mu'^2\,\lambda^{(n)}(\mathbf s),\qquad\lambda^{(n)}(\mathbf s):=\sum_{a=1}^{n}D_S(s_a)\qquad[\mathrm{Def\text{-}BM.14}(3);\ \mathrm{BM.111}(2)];$$
$$(3)\quad\textbf{the materialization threshold:}\qquad\textbf{constitutive clause:}\ \ \text{a resonance materializes when the locally available rest energy reaches its own scale},$$
$$E_{\mathrm{rest}}=N\,m_{\mathrm{hid}}(\mathcal R)=\frac{N\,E_{\mathrm{int}}(\mathcal R)\ln2}{\mathfrak h}\qquad[\mathrm{BM.34}(4),(7):\ E=N\sqrt{m^2+p^2}-N^ip_i\ \text{at}\ p=0,\ N^i=0;\ \mathrm{BM.88}(2)(\mathrm{iii}):\ \text{the lapse}]:$$
$$\boxed{\ \textbf{the materialization condition:}\qquad N\,E\ \ge\ \mathcal T_0(\mathcal R)\ :=\ \frac{E_{\mathrm{int}}(\mathcal R)\,\mathfrak h}{\ln2}\ }\qquad[E\ \text{the local energy scale};\ \text{machine: one Laurent monomial}];$$
$$\mathcal T(\mathcal R;\,N)\ :=\ \frac{\mathcal T_0(\mathcal R)}{N}\ =\ \frac{E_{\mathrm{int}}(\mathcal R)\,\mathfrak h}{N\,\ln2}\qquad[\text{the threshold as a function of the lapse alone};\ \text{machine}];$$
$$\textbf{the curvature read (exact, via the lock):}\qquad G=2\pi E_{\mathrm{int}}^2\ln2\implies E_{\mathrm{int}}=\sqrt{\frac{G}{2\pi\ln2}}\implies\boxed{\ \mathcal T(\mathcal R;\,G,N)\ =\ \frac{\mathfrak h}{N\,\ln2}\sqrt{\frac{G}{2\pi\ln2}}\ }\qquad[\mathrm{BM.16}(1);\ \mathrm{BM.88}(3);\ \text{machine}];$$
$$\textbf{the horizon read (comparison scale, quarantined):}\qquad r_s=\frac{\mathfrak h E_{\mathrm{int}}}2=2G_Nm_{\mathrm{hid}}\implies\boxed{\ \mathcal T(\mathcal R;\,r_s,N)\ =\ \frac{2\,r_s}{N}\ }\qquad[\mathrm{BM.15}(4);\ \mathrm{CT2.9};\ \mathrm{P3}:\ G_N\ \text{is a named combination for external comparison};\ \neg\text{a horizon identification}\ [\mathrm{BM.15}\ \text{comparison discipline}]];$$

$$(6)\quad\textbf{the standing orders, as scope clauses:}\qquad(\mathrm i)\ \ \neg\textbf{a cosmological coordinate exists:}\ \text{the ledger knows the local tick}\ \tau\ [\mathrm{A6};\ \mathrm{D1.8}],\ \text{the local curvature}\ G\ [\mathrm{BM.88}(3)],\ \text{the local lapse}\ N\ [\mathrm{BM.88}(2)(\mathrm{iii})]\ \text{and the local energy scale}\ E\ [\mathrm{BM.88}(2)(\mathrm i)];\ \neg\text{an age and}\ \neg\text{a global time};$$
$$(\mathrm{ii})\quad\neg\textbf{a binary stable/unstable category:}\qquad\textbf{every eigenvalue of every multi-chain ensemble is a resonance};\qquad\text{``stable''}\ :=\ \Gamma\ \text{evaluates to}\ 0\ \text{at the ambient calibration point}\ [(5)];\qquad\text{``unstable'' or ``heavy''}\ :=\ \text{the local parameters cross}\ \mathcal T\ \text{or open}\ \mathcal N\ [(3),(4)];$$

$$\textbf{beyond this tier:}\ \ \mathsf g(G)\ [\mathrm{BM.104}(5)],\quad e_0\ [\mathrm{EM.25}(7)],\quad N\ \text{as solution data}\ [\mathrm{CT2.7};\ \mathrm{BM.34}(2)],\quad\rho_{\mathrm B}\ [\mathrm{A\text{-}BM.9}],\quad(\mathrm{R3})\ \text{the flavour composition},\quad(\mathrm{R8})\ \text{the}\ 2\text{-chain sector masses}.$$

**Rmk (why "resonance" and not "particle").** Clause (6)(ii) is the tier's standing order written as a scope clause, and it is a statement about the mathematics rather than a naming preference: the ensemble's eigenvalues are indexed by the tuple of (1), each carries a threshold function and a width function, and both are exact symbolic functions of the four local parameters. Nothing in the construction distinguishes an eigenvalue whose width happens to vanish at one calibration point from one whose width happens not to; the difference is a value of a function, not a category. The word *particle* would import a binary the ledger does not carry, and the word *resonance* imports nothing: it names an eigenvalue with two functions attached.

**Rmk (the horizon row's quarantine).** Clause (3)'s third form is written with $r_s$, which BM.15(4) builds from $G_N$ — a named combination of the single scale for external comparison, not an input [P3]. The row is a change of variable inside the corpus's own monomial and it is quarantined exactly as BM.15's comparison discipline requires: no collapse reading, no horizon identification, and no claim that any resonance sits at any measured radius.

**Pf.**
$$
\text{Definition block: the constitutive clauses are}\ (1)\text{'s tuple and the definitional forms of}\ (3),(4);\ \text{the non-derived clause is}\ (4)\text{'s product form};\ (2),(3)\text{'s three exact forms and}\ (5)\text{'s five rows are derived and machine-checked};\ (6),(7)\ \text{are scope records}.\ \blacksquare
$$

**Phys.** A resonance is a five-entry tuple — how many chains, which seal, which charge class, which six states, which winding — and it carries two functions of the local parameters. The first says when it appears: the rest energy the metric's own ADM split gives is the lapse times the mass, so the resonance materializes when the local scale times the lapse reaches its edge count times the single scale over the log of two, and the same condition read through the calibration lock is a square root of the local curvature, or read through the comparison radius it is twice that radius over the lapse. The second says how fast it goes: the frozen per-tick transition weight, times the envelope fraction that vanishes at the member's own width, times the effective coupling over the bare one, times the count of strictly lighter resonances in its class, times the exact indicator that it is materialized at all. Both functions vanish for whole regions rather than for special objects — at the sharp crystallization threshold nothing decays, at the envelope nothing decays, and the lightest member of every class has nothing lighter to go to, so its width is zero by count. That is the entire content of "stable": a function evaluating to zero where it is being evaluated. Two scope clauses carry the tier's standing orders: no cosmological coordinate exists, because the ledger owns a tick, a curvature, a lapse and a scale and nothing global, and no binary category exists, because every eigenvalue is a resonance and the adjectives are values. The third says nothing is forbidden, since every threshold is a finite positive number at every positive lapse, so every locus is non-empty.

In the transport register the generating function is the same Laurent monomial at every chain count — one plus z plus one over z, raised to n, which is one plus z to the two n over z to the n — so the class weight is a binomial coefficient, the sum is four to the n, and the whole spectrum is one root at minus one with multiplicity twice the chain count. The first level is formed but not sealed, since a lone attachment is never sealed, which is why the ladder starts at two. In the defect register the eigenvalues are sums of the six branch values, and they all live in one exact field of degree sixteen over the rationals built from root two, root three and twice the cosine of eighteen degrees, whose own relation makes root five a polynomial in it — so equality of two eigenvalues is a decidable integer question rather than a numerical one. The orbit law is clean: the symmetric group permutes the constituent slots, the eigenvalue is invariant, the orbit count is a multiset binomial, and the multiplicity of each eigenvalue is the orbit size, a divisor of n factorial. Fifteen and twenty appear, and they are exactly the wedge-square dimension and the three-subset count of the six states — but the tier says plainly that these are counts and not representation dimensions, because the flavour symmetry the corpus derives is a cyclic three and not a special unitary six. The three-chain ladder has fifty-six orbits and fifty-five eigenvalues, and the single collision is the one the constituent census had already found: two plus two plus two equals four plus one plus one, because three of the six defect values are the powers one, two and four. The minimal-polynomial degrees climb one, two, four, eight, sixteen with the number of distinct irrational ingredients, and exactly one three-chain resonance — the sum of the root-two, cosine and root-three branches — generates the whole field.

Read in the local scale it is the resonance's edge count times the single free scale over the log of two, divided by the lapse, so a deeper lapse lowers every threshold in the ladder at once and the whole spectrum moves as one function. Read in the local curvature it is a square root, because the calibration lock makes the curvature a derived quadratic function of the same count — and the lock is free of the scale, free of the cosmological term and free of every declared parameter, so the curvature reading adds no datum. Read in the comparison radius it is twice the radius over the lapse, and that row is quarantined exactly as the corpus quarantines every $G_N$-built quantity: no collapse reading, no horizon identification, no measured radius. The ladders themselves are exact integer sets — five values for one chain, fifteen for a meson, thirty-three for a baryon — running from twice the chain count to sixty times it, so the span ratio is exactly thirty at every level and the curvature span is exactly nine hundred. Then the row that answers the question about forbidden states: every threshold is a finite positive number at every positive lapse, so every locus is a nonempty half-line, and all two hundred sixteen ordered constituent triples sit inside it. Nothing is excluded; what differs is where in the local scale the half-line starts. Both regimes the question names — a collider and a deep-gravity region — are the same evaluation of the same function at different local parameters, one raising the scale and one lowering the lapse, and neither needs a mechanism, a cosmological clock, or a new object.

**Phys.** The width is a product of four things the corpus had already frozen and one thing it can count. The flicker factor is the transition content of the Janus resolvent at unit fugacity, a rational function of the single crystallization threshold that climbs from zero to exactly a third at the threshold's midpoint and is strictly increasing all the way. The envelope factor is one minus one over k, which vanishes at the member's own Born width. The coupling factor is the effective coupling over the bare one, the lapse times the envelope fraction times the priced curvature composition. The count is how many strictly lighter resonances sit in the same chain-count, seal and charge class. And the indicator says whether the resonance is materialized at all. Three of those give exact zeros with distinct mechanisms: no flicker means no dissolution move and hence no transition weight; sitting at your own envelope means the enclosed flux fraction is zero; and being the lightest in your class means there is nothing to go to, so the count is zero and the width is zero by arithmetic. The fourth zero is different in kind and the tier keeps it apart — an unmaterialized resonance has no width because it has no ensemble, which is absence rather than stability. The bound follows by composing the factor bounds, and the lifetime floor is three ticks at the extreme, exactly as the vertex tier derived, with no second anywhere in it. Energy enters monotonically: raising the local scale raises the envelope ratio, raises the enclosed fraction, and raises every width, so "low energy" and "high energy" are two points on one function where the widths are respectively all zero and open in the order of their thresholds and their counts. The two-sided bar on the mass splitting is the same product seen from the other side, and its band is exactly the bound on the width's coupling factor.

Twenty appears, and it is exactly the count of ways to pick three distinct states from six, which is also where the epsilon seal's free symmetric-group action lives; the tier states plainly that this is an orbit count and not a decuplet dimension, because the flavour symmetry the corpus derives is a cyclic three and there is no special unitary three anywhere in the inventory. The octet adjudication is re-certified and extended: the derived three is colour's, the derived eight is a barred capacity ratio, the derived ten is a grammar count, and eight does not occur among any of the four grouping families at any formed level. The ceilings behave exactly as they should — the single-chain pole ceiling is four, the composite ceiling is four times the chain count and is attained by the heaviest branch at every level, and a composite eigenvalue is a sum of single-chain reads rather than a single-chain read, so no ceiling is violated and none is extended. And the count that answers the forbidden-state question a second time is the simplest one: all two hundred sixteen ordered constituent triples are formed resonances with nonempty threshold loci, so the two heaviest compositions anyone might name are unread rather than unreachable.

**Phys.** Four objectives came in and four derived verdicts went out, with nothing declared. The conjugate is forced: total charge vanishes in every valid universe, the tick has no inverse so the compensator must be a configuration rather than a reversed evolution, and of the derived maps exactly one produces a configuration with the negated charge, the dual attachment, the opposite ray and the same edge count — which makes it mass-degenerate by structure, since not one of the seven geometric reads carries a charge exponent. The pair it forms is neutral, weighs exactly twice a member, and is created with the Janus resolvent's own weight, a parabola in the single crystallization threshold with maximum one quarter at one eighth and zeros at both ends, so pairs appear exactly where the ledger flickers. The meson is the unique seal at two attachments and it brings the corpus's first two-chain state space, which is what three successive tiers said a statistics had no referent without; the specification written as a build-spec in the open-construction list is discharged as written, and the charge side is exact — the three self-conjugate pairs saturate the neutral class at six with nothing left over, while the charged classes are made of pairs that are not conjugates. The exchange operator is the flip composed with the transport its own identification forces, which is what makes it an involution for every winding, and its sign on the symmetric sector is the fourth-root phase at the half-turn, which is the winding's parity, which is $(-1)^{2j}$: deficit eleven closes on a phase alphabet and an additivity law, with no Lorentz argument, no positivity of energy and no microcausality, and with the earlier spin-parity refutation standing untouched because that one was about the kind and this one is about the winding. The spectrum is counted rather than named: two characteristic polynomials, one binomial transport census and one defect ladder inside a degree-sixteen field with exactly one collision in two hundred sixteen triples, threshold ladders spanning a factor of thirty at every level, and a width that is a product of four frozen factors and one count with three exact zeros and a three-tick floor. Nothing is forbidden and nothing is categorically stable; what varies is where a threshold sits and what a function evaluates to. Two residues were added, one sector choice was priced, and no measured number entered anywhere.

## Tier BM.22 — The Annihilation Channel, Concrete Spin, and Fermion Identification: the Janus Tunnel, the Zig-Zag World Line, and the Spin-Dependent Transport Defect

**Locus.** This tier takes the residue $(\mathrm{R9})$ that $\mathrm{BM.118}(7)$ named — *the annihilation channel: an inter-sector transition operator, $\neg$in the inventory* — and constructs the channel, then follows the two chains that fall out of it: the concrete spin and the composite statistics. The crossing is not a velocity and the tier says so first: $c=1$ is a convention, the dispersion gives a strict subluminal deficit $1-v=m^2/(E(E+p))>0$ at every finite momentum, and the boundary the corpus actually derives between the materialized and the fluctuation content is the **Janus real/virtual register**, whose $\mathcal V$ sector is the maximally raw-entropic state $\rho_\circ=\tfrac14I$ with no fermion terminus at $|E_{\mathcal R}|=0$ ($\mathrm{BM.119}$). On that register the crossing operator is derived, not posited: the two moves $\hat J_\pm$ of $\mathrm{D1.2}$, the master generator $Q=x_+(\hat J_+-P_{\mathcal V})+x_-(\hat J_--P_{\mathcal R})$, its one-dimensional kernel giving the stationary measure, its spectrum $\{0,-(x_++x_-)\}$, and detailed balance as a theorem ($\mathrm{BM.120}$). The zig-zag is then the resolvent's own evenness — $(\hat U^{2m})_{\varnothing\varnothing}=(x_+x_-)^m$ with every odd term zero — so each term is a create-propagate-annihilate round trip whose legs all run forward in the ledger order, and the "backward leg" of a diagram is here the CP-conjugate *configuration* on a forward leg, which is why no inverse tick is needed ($\mathrm{BM.121}$). The pair channel is derived with its charge balance, its exact threshold, its weight and its three CP legs — the nilpotent weak step for the charge inversion, the CP transport for the parity inversion, the local scale for the energy — while the two-photon supply is barred on four named grounds, so the channel closes and the amplitude does not ($\mathrm{BM.122}$). Annihilation is the reverse move, its content returning to the $\mathcal V$ sector at the entropy maximum rather than into radiation legs, and $(\mathrm{R9})$ closes at the channel level with the cross-section residue narrowing to the momentum-space resolvent and the gauge coupling of the charge read ($\mathrm{BM.123}$). On the spin side the tier separates two angles that a single-symbol reading would fuse: the winding $\Theta$ and the frame-holonomy angle $\Theta_R$ are provably not proportional, on a dimension mismatch, so the spin-dependent transport defect is a **multiplet ladder** $\Delta(m)=4\sin^2(m\Theta_R/4)$ over $m\in\{k,k-2,\dots,-k\}$ and not a number $\Delta(j)$ ($\mathrm{BM.124}$, $\mathrm{BM.125}$). A spin-dependent crossing weight is refuted on the four standing grounds, and what survives is a *domain* correlation rather than a prohibition ($\mathrm{BM.126}$). The winding parity is then a ledger read, separated from the $\mathrm{D1.5}$ kind read that $\mathrm{BM.106}(1)$ already showed cannot carry a spin-parity theorem ($\mathrm{BM.127}$). Finally the three-chain exchange structure is built — $\mathcal H_3$, the $S_3$ action with its exact character formula $d^{\,c(\sigma)}$, and the vanishing of $\wedge^3(\mathbb C^2)$ against the one-dimensionality of $\wedge^3(\mathbb C^3)$, which is why the baryon's antisymmetry is colour's and the statistics is the winding's — giving the multiplicative exchange law $\varepsilon=\prod_a\varepsilon(c_a)$, the meson's unconditional boson sign, and the baryon's sign as an exact function of its three constituent windings ($\mathrm{BM.128}$, $\mathrm{BM.129}$). $\mathrm{BM.130}$ adjudicates.

### Def-BM.18 — The Janus register and its crossing operators

**Def.** A construction on $\mathrm{D1.1}$–$\mathrm{D1.2}$'s real/virtual distinction, $\mathrm{FT.108}(4)$'s master generator and $\mathrm{Def\text{-}BM.16}$'s two-chain space; no new axiom, no new datum, no new parameter, no velocity operator, no position operator, no external scattering object.

$$(1)\quad\textbf{the register:}\qquad\boxed{\ \mathcal J\ :=\ \operatorname{span}_{\mathbb C}\bigl\{|\mathcal V\rangle,\ |\mathcal R\rangle\bigr\}\ \cong\ \mathbb C^2\ }\qquad\text{in the}\ (\text{virtual},\ \text{real})\ \text{order of}\ \mathrm{FT.108}(4);$$
$$e\in\mathcal R\iff\bigl|\Pi_{\mathcal V}\rho\bigr|\le\varepsilon_q\ \vee\ \bigl|\Pi_{\mathcal V}\rho\bigr|\ge1-\varepsilon_q;\qquad\neg\text{registration}\implies e\in\mathcal V\qquad[\mathrm{A4};\ \mathrm{D1.1};\ \mathrm{CT0.1}]:$$

$$(2)\quad\textbf{the two crossing operators:}\qquad\boxed{\ \hat J_+\ :=\ |\mathcal R\rangle\langle\mathcal V|\ \ (\text{crystallization},\ J^+:\ n_{\mathcal R}:0\to1),\qquad\hat J_-\ :=\ |\mathcal V\rangle\langle\mathcal R|\ \ (\text{dissolution},\ J^-:\ n_{\mathcal R}:1\to0)\ }$$

$$(3)\quad\textbf{the master generator:}\qquad\boxed{\ Q\ :=\ \begin{pmatrix}-x_+&x_+\\ x_-&-x_-\end{pmatrix}\ \ \text{over}\ \ \mathbb Z[x_+,x_-]\ }\qquad[\mathrm{FT.108}(4):\ \text{the per-pair Janus dynamics}]:$$
$$\textbf{the decomposition (derived, recorded here):}\qquad Q\ =\ x_+\bigl(\hat J_+-P_{\mathcal V}\bigr)\ +\ x_-\bigl(\hat J_--P_{\mathcal R}\bigr)\qquad[\text{machine: entrywise at six rational witnesses}];$$
$$\textbf{constitutive clause:}\ \ Q\ \text{is}\ \mathrm{FT.108}(4)\text{'s own generator,}\ \neg\text{a new dynamics};\qquad\textbf{the row convention:}\ \ Q\ \text{acts on row vectors, so}\ Q_{ij}\ \text{is the rate from}\ i\ \text{to}\ j;$$
$$(4)\quad\textbf{the crossing space of a chain:}\qquad\boxed{\ \mathcal T_{\mathcal J}(c)\ :=\ \mathcal J\ \otimes\ \mathcal H_\omega(c)\ \otimes\ \Psi(c),\qquad\dim\mathcal T_{\mathcal J}(c)\ =\ 4\,\bigl(|k(c)|+1\bigr)\ }$$
$$[\mathrm{Def\text{-}H.33};\ \mathrm{Def\text{-}H.38};\ \mathrm{Def\text{-}BM.16}(1);\ \text{machine: exact integers}];\qquad\textbf{the pair crossing space:}\quad\mathcal T_{\mathcal J}^{\,2}(c):=\mathcal T_{\mathcal J}(c)\otimes\mathcal T_{\mathcal J}(c^{\mathrm{CP}}),\qquad\dim=16\,\bigl(|k|+1\bigr)^2;$$

$$\textbf{an annihilation}\ :=\ \hat J_-\ \text{on the same two registers};\qquad\textbf{weight}\ x_-^2\ \text{one-way,}\ x_+x_-\ \text{per round trip};$$

$$\textbf{the kind bar:}\qquad\mathcal J\ \text{is}\ \neg\mathcal H_\omega\ \text{and}\ \neg\text{one of the four single-object}\ \mathbb Z_2\ \text{gradings}\ [\mathrm{BM.106}(4);\ \mathrm{BM.112}(5);\ \mathrm{FT.125}(5);\ \mathrm{FT.89}(2)]:$$

$$\textbf{the scope inherited at every use:}\ \ \mathrm{Def\text{-}H.32}\text{'s}\ (\mathrm{S1})\text{--}(\mathrm{S4});\qquad\mathrm{Def\text{-}H.38}\text{'s nonnegative cone and its}\ k\ge3\ \text{aspect bar};\qquad\mathrm{BM.8}(2)\text{'s stationarity hypothesis for any chart evolution};$$
$$\neg\text{a P4 addition},\quad\neg\text{a new dimensionful scale}\ [\mathrm{P1}],\quad\neg\text{a measured value}\ [\mathrm{P5}],\quad\neg\text{a species identification}\ [\mathrm{Def\text{-}BM.3}(7)],\quad\neg\text{a rate datum}\ [\mathrm{Cal\text{-}F}\ \text{carries no rate};\ \mathrm{BM.44}(5)];$$
$$\textbf{beyond this tier:}\ \ \text{the momentum-space}\ \Sigma\text{-resolvent}\ [\mathrm{BM.6}(6)],\qquad\text{the gauge coupling of the charge read}\ [\mathrm{Def\text{-}BM.8}(8)].$$

**Rmk (what the register is and is not).** $\mathcal J$ is the two-state register of *one pair* across the crystallization criterion — the object D1.2 named and FT.108 derived a stationary measure for. It is not a spacetime, not a world line, and not a Hilbert space of asymptotic states. Clause (6)'s kind bar is the load-bearing one: the corpus has an orientation doublet $\mathcal H_\omega$ per chain, and it would be a category error to read the real/virtual distinction as that doublet's two rays, exactly as it would be to read a single-chain grade as a permutation sign. The zig-zag of clause (5) is a word in two moves, recorded forward, and its weight is a monomial in $x_+$ and $x_-$.

**Req.** A4, A6, D0.8, D1.1, D1.2, D1.8 (Part 1); CT0.1, CT0.8, CT2.1, D2.9 (Part 1, Part 2); P1, P3, P4, P5 (Parts 1–2); Def-H.21(5), Def-H.21(6), Def-H.32, Def-H.33, Def-H.38, FT.22, FT.89(2), FT.108(4), FT.108(5), FT.125(5) (Part 3); Def-BM.3(7), Def-BM.15(3), Def-BM.16(1), BM.2(2), BM.6(6), BM.8(2), BM.10(1), BM.25(4), BM.27(6), BM.27(7), BM.29(5), BM.44(5), BM.106(4), BM.112(5), BM.118(7) (this part); exact $2\times2$ matrix algebra over $\mathbb Z[x_+,x_-]$ and over $\mathbb Q(i)$, exact integer dimension arithmetic [math; machine: `checks/verify_H_janus_tunnel_concrete_spin.py` §A].

**Pf.**
$$
\text{Definition block: the constitutive clauses are}\ (1)\text{'s register},\ (2)\text{'s two moves and}\ (5)\text{'s three names};\ \text{the non-derived clauses are the basis order of}\ (1)\ \text{and the row convention of}\ (3);\ (3)\text{'s decomposition and}\ (4)\text{'s dimensions are derived and machine-checked};\ (6),(7)\ \text{are bars and scope records}.\ \blacksquare
$$

**Phys.** One pair, crossing a criterion, has two states and two moves, and the corpus already derived both: D1.2 named the seal as a transition across the A4 criterion in either branch, and FT.108 wrote down the master generator whose kernel is one-dimensional and gives the stationary measure. This definition makes the two moves into operators on a two-dimensional register, decomposes the generator as a sum of jump-minus-loss terms with the two derived weights, and tensors the register with the chain's own orientation doublet and winding carrier to give a crossing space of exact finite dimension. Three words are then defined and no more: a pair creation is the crystallization move on two registers whose members are identified as a CP-pair, an annihilation is the dissolution move on the same two, and a zig-zag is a finite alternating word in the two moves, every step recorded in ledger order. What the definition refuses is the vocabulary that would overreach — no velocity operator, no position operator, no momentum-space state, no cross-section, no S-matrix, and above all no identification of the real/virtual register with the orientation doublet, which is a different two-dimensional object doing different work.

**Rmk (why the refutation is the useful half).** Clause (2) is a one-line algebraic identity, and it does more work than it looks: it says the corpus cannot describe a massive chain arriving at $c$, because at every finite momentum there is an exact positive gap whose size is the mass squared over a product of two energies. **Phys.** Three of the four claims in the question have no referent, and the tier says which and why. The speed of light is a unit convention here, not a threshold; a massive chain never reaches it, because the dispersion gives an exact positive gap equal to the mass squared over a product of two energies, and every materialized chain has a strictly positive informational mass from the two-bit floor upward. So nothing crosses by accelerating. What the corpus does derive is a boundary of a different kind: when no edge is registered the pair sits in the virtual sector at the maximally raw-entropic state, one quarter of the identity, which is the unique argmax, and with no real edges there are no closed chains and hence no fermion termini at all. That partition — registered against unregistered — is the materialized sector's boundary, and crossing it is a move with a weight, not a limit of a velocity. The weight is a polynomial in the single crystallization threshold: four epsilon for dissolution, one minus four epsilon for crystallization, and at the sharp threshold the dissolution weight is exactly zero so nothing crosses back. The refutation is the useful half, because it relocates the question onto an object that exists and is finite, exact, and already carries a derived stationary measure.

### BM.120 — The Janus tunnel: the crossing operators, the exact spectrum, and detailed balance

**Thm.**
$$(1)\quad\textbf{the move algebra (exact, over}\ \mathbb Q\text{):}\qquad\hat J_+^2=0,\qquad\hat J_-^2=0,\qquad\hat J_+\hat J_-=P_{\mathcal V},\qquad\hat J_-\hat J_+=P_{\mathcal R},\qquad\{\hat J_+,\hat J_-\}=\mathrm{id}$$
$$[\text{machine: all five identities entrywise on the}\ 2\times2\ \text{register}];\qquad\boxed{\ \textbf{each move is nilpotent and the two anticommute to the identity}\ }$$
$$\textbf{the reading:}\quad\hat J_+\hat J_-=P_{\mathcal V}\ \text{is the round trip}\ \mathcal V\to\mathcal R\to\mathcal V;\qquad\hat J_-\hat J_+=P_{\mathcal R}\ \text{is the round trip}\ \mathcal R\to\mathcal V\to\mathcal R;$$
$$\neg\exists\ \text{a doubled move in the same direction}\ —\ \textbf{the}\ \mathrm{A4}\ \textbf{criterion is binary, and the nilpotency is its operator form}\ [\mathrm{D1.2};\ \mathrm{BM.23}(2)\text{'s overflow pattern}];$$
$$(2)\quad\textbf{the generator decomposes as jump minus loss:}\qquad\boxed{\ Q\ =\ x_+\bigl(\hat J_+-P_{\mathcal V}\bigr)\ +\ x_-\bigl(\hat J_--P_{\mathcal R}\bigr)\ }\qquad[\mathrm{FT.108}(4);\ \text{machine: entrywise at six rational witnesses}\ (x_+,x_-)\in\{(\tfrac12,\tfrac12),(\tfrac34,\tfrac14),(1,0),(0,1),(\tfrac23,\tfrac13),(\tfrac78,\tfrac18)\}];$$
$$\textbf{the row-sum law:}\qquad Q\ \text{acts on row vectors and every row sums to zero:}\quad(-x_+)+x_+=0,\qquad x_-+(-x_-)=0\qquad[\text{machine}]:$$
$$\therefore\ Q\ \textbf{is a master generator and}\ \neg\textbf{a unitary}\ —\ \text{the crossing is a stochastic ledger move,}\ \neg\text{a rotation of a state};$$
$$(3)\quad\textbf{the kernel, the stationary measure and detailed balance:}\qquad(x_-,\ x_+)\,Q\ =\ \bigl(x_-(-x_+)+x_+x_-,\ \ x_-x_++x_+(-x_-)\bigr)\ =\ (0,\ 0)\qquad[\text{machine: exact in}\ \mathbb Z[x_+,x_-]];$$
$$\det Q\ =\ (-x_+)(-x_-)-x_+x_-\ =\ 0,\qquad Q\ne0\implies\operatorname{rk}Q=1,\qquad\dim\ker Q=1\qquad[\mathrm{FT.108}(4);\ \text{machine}];$$
$$\boxed{\ p\ =\ \frac{x_+}{x_++x_-}\ =\ 1-4\varepsilon_q\ \ \textbf{identically}\ }\qquad[\mathrm{BM.19}(2);\ \text{machine: exact at seven rational thresholds}];$$
$$\textbf{detailed balance is derived, not assumed:}\qquad p_{\mathcal V}\,x_+\ =\ p_{\mathcal R}\,x_-\iff\frac{x_-}{x_++x_-}\,x_+=\frac{x_+}{x_++x_-}\,x_-\iff x_-x_+=x_+x_-\qquad[\mathrm{FT.108}(4);\ \text{machine}];$$
$$(4)\quad\textbf{the exact spectrum:}\qquad\operatorname{tr}Q=-(x_++x_-),\qquad\det Q=0\implies\boxed{\ \operatorname{spec}Q=\bigl\{0,\ -(x_++x_-)\bigr\}\ }\qquad[\text{machine: the characteristic polynomial}\ \lambda^2+(x_++x_-)\lambda];$$
$$\textbf{at the specialization}\ x_++x_-=1:\qquad\operatorname{spec}Q=\{0,\ -1\},\qquad\operatorname{tr}Q=-1,\qquad\operatorname{rk}Q=1\qquad[\text{machine}];$$
$$\boxed{\ \textbf{the zero eigenvalue is the stationary mode and}\ -1\ \textbf{is the relaxation mode at unit total weight}\ }\qquad[\text{machine: the two eigenvectors}\ (x_-,x_+)\ \text{and}\ (1,-1)];$$
$$(5)\quad\textbf{the tunnel operator and its weights:}\qquad\textbf{one-way creation}\ \hat J_+:\ \text{weight}\ x_+=1-4\varepsilon_q\in(0,1];\qquad\textbf{one-way annihilation}\ \hat J_-:\ \text{weight}\ x_-=4\varepsilon_q\in[0,1);$$
$$\textbf{the round trip:}\qquad\boxed{\ \mathcal W_{\text{round}}\ =\ x_+x_-\ =\ 4\varepsilon_q(1-4\varepsilon_q)\ =\ \frac14-16\Bigl(\varepsilon_q-\frac18\Bigr)^{\!2}\ \le\ \frac14\ }\qquad[\mathrm{BM.109}(2);\ \mathrm{BM.44}(1);\ \text{machine: the SOS completion and the}\ 256\text{-point grid}];$$

$$[\text{machine: the AM--GM row on exact rationals, equality locus verified}];\qquad\boxed{\ \textbf{the round-trip weight is maximal exactly where the two moves balance}\ }$$

**Phys.** The crossing has an algebra and it is small enough to write down completely. Each move squares to zero, because the crystallization criterion is binary and a pair cannot crystallize twice without dissolving in between; the two moves anticommute to the identity, and their two products are exactly the two round trips. The generator is the sum of a jump term and a loss term for each move, its rows sum to zero, and it is therefore a master generator rather than a unitary — the crossing is a stochastic ledger move, not a rotation of a state. Its kernel is the line spanned by the two weights, which is where the stationary measure comes from, and detailed balance is an identity rather than an assumption: the flux out of the virtual state equals the flux out of the real one at that measure, because both are the same product. The spectrum is zero and minus the total weight, so at unit total weight there is one stationary mode and one relaxation mode with rate exactly one. The round-trip weight is the familiar parabola with maximum one quarter, and the maximum sits exactly where the two moves balance — an AM–GM equality, not a coincidence. Two clarifications keep the construction honest. The register is not the orientation doublet: one carries an involution, the other carries nilpotents, and no isomorphism respects both algebras, so the crossing operator acts on the register tensored with the chain's own spaces. And the bidirectionality is in the move set, not in the tick: the ensemble sums both moves and has a stationary measure, while the ledger only grows and the reversed history remains inadmissible at its first event.

**Phys.** The zig-zag is not drawn, it is summed, and the sum turns out to be even. A return to the vacuum needs as many crystallizations as dissolutions, and since neither move can be applied twice in a row the words strictly alternate — so every odd matrix element vanishes identically and the vacuum-to-vacuum resolvent is a geometric series in the square of the fugacity with ratio the round-trip weight. That is the whole content of the zig-zag: term by term it is a create-propagate-annihilate excursion, weighted by the parabola to the power of the number of excursions, maximal at one eighth of the threshold and exactly zero at both endpoints, so the entire ladder is annihilated by a non-flickering ledger. The pole sits at fugacity two or beyond and never enters the unit disc. Three independent rows say why no leg runs backward: the tick has no inverse, the pure reversal of a completed history is inadmissible at its first event, and — the sharpest of the three — the corpus's own record involution fixes every completed alternating word pointwise, so the reversed reading of a zig-zag is literally the same word. What looks like a backward-propagating member in a diagram is here the CP-conjugate configuration carried forward, with equal modulus and a phase that is exactly one on the materialized locus. And the ledger keeps its own accounting: a round trip restores the register while the record grows by the events it logged, which is precisely the one thing a forward-only ledger can support.

The threshold is one Laurent monomial: twice the constituent edge count times the single scale over the log of two, which at the digon floor is four units, the very minimum of the two-chain ladder the resonance tier already computed. The weight is the square of the crystallization weight times the indicator that the local scale has reached that threshold, and its two limits are exact opposites — at the sharp threshold creation is certain and annihilation impossible, while near full dissolution creation itself vanishes. The CP structure decomposes into three derived legs: a nilpotent step operator that fires from the occupied ray alone and whose orientation image fires from the other, the CP transport phase that is exactly one on the materialized locus, and the local scale against the threshold. What does not exist is the supply vertex. So the channel is derived and the amplitude is not, and the tier records both halves rather than promoting one into the other.

At the sharp threshold the ratio is zero: nothing annihilates, which is the same statement as the no-flicker theorem seen from the other side. The round trip that joins the two directions carries the familiar parabola, and the resolvent that sums all round trips has its pole at fugacity two or beyond. What happens to the content is exact and slightly austere: a dissolved pair returns to the virtual sector at one quarter of the identity, the unique maximizer of the raw entropy, and the ledger's own entropy read goes to zero with the registered count — so nothing is carried off by radiation, because no supply vertex exists to carry it. That absence is what keeps the frozen rows honest: there is still no direct operator between the two charge sectors and they remain amplitude-equal orbits of one involution, and what the tier adds is a mediated channel through the virtual sector, composed of the two Janus moves and the CP identification. Residue (R9) closes at exactly that level — a channel with a weight, a threshold, a balance and a destination — and narrows into two named successors, the cross-section which needs a momentum-space resolvent and a gauge coupling of the charge read, and the radiation legs which need a transit supply vertex. The arrow is untouched throughout: the reversibility lives in the move set and its stationary measure, never in the tick.

$$\textbf{the bar:}\qquad\neg\text{a product of the two}\ \mathrm{Def\text{-}H.37}\ \text{clauses' factors is a derived mass}\ —\ \text{the formed rows are the two clauses and their matching identity}\ (6);\qquad\neg\text{a}\ k\text{--}\Theta_R\ \text{proportionality is asserted anywhere};$$
$$\neg\text{a P4 addition},\quad\neg\text{a new dimensionful scale}\ [\mathrm{P1}],\quad\neg\text{a measured value}\ [\mathrm{P5}],\quad\neg\text{a species identification}\ [\mathrm{Def\text{-}BM.3}(7)],\quad\neg\text{a currency conversion}\ [\mathrm{BM.83}(3)].$$

**Rmk (why the defect is a ladder and not a number).** A single-valued $\Delta(j)$ would require the frame-holonomy angle to be a function of the winding, and that identification is ruled out on a dimension count: the winding carries the free scale with weight minus two while the holonomy angle is dimensionless. What the corpus derives instead is a ladder — the defect read evaluated at each weight of the spin multiplet — so the spin fixes how many values there are ($2j+1$ of them) and which one is exactly zero when $k$ is even, while $\Theta_R$ remains a separate datum whose ledger realization is residue (R2). Reading the ladder as a number is the same category error as reading a count as a strength, and the definition bars it explicitly.

**Req.** D2.9 (Parts 1–2); CT2.1 (Part 2); P1, P4, P5 (Parts 1–2); Def-H.21(5), Def-H.21(6), Def-H.37, Def-H.38, FT.22, FT.54(1), FT.54(4), FT.55(1), FT.60(5), FT.76(3), EM.24(5) (Part 3); EW.33 (Part 2); Census FT.63(4) (row-wise); Def-BM.3(7), Def-BM.14(3), BM.67(9), BM.67(10), BM.82(1), BM.82(6), BM.83(3), BM.114(3), A-BM.9 (this part); the Chebyshev recursion over $\mathbb Z[x]$, exact radical identities, $\mathfrak q$-exponent arithmetic [math; machine: `checks/verify_H_janus_tunnel_concrete_spin.py` §C].

**Pf.**
$$
\text{Definition block: the constitutive clause is}\ (3)\text{'s locus of the spin-dependence};\ \text{the non-derived clauses are}\ \neg\text{present}\ —\ (1)\text{'s dimensions},\ (2)\text{'s no-go},\ (4)\text{'s recursion},\ (5)\text{'s zero and}\ (6)\text{'s ceiling are all derived or re-cited};\ (7),(8)\ \text{are residue and scope records}.\ \blacksquare
$$

**Phys.** Two angles appear in this corpus and they are not the same object: the winding, which counts the line element around a closed chain and carries the free scale, and the frame-holonomy angle, which is dimensionless. Their identification is ruled out by that dimension mismatch alone, so a transport defect that depended on the winding through the holonomy formula cannot be formed. What is formed is better: a ladder. The spin fixes the multiplet, the multiplet has two-j-plus-one weights spaced by two, and the defect read at each weight is two minus two cosines of that weight times half the holonomy angle — equivalently four sine-squared of a quarter, and equivalently an integer polynomial in the cosine through the Chebyshev recursion. Two rows fall out exactly. Whenever the winding is even the ladder contains the weight zero, and the defect at weight zero is identically zero at every curvature flux, which is a standing massless state in the middle of the ladder rather than a tuning. And the whole ladder is bounded by four times the defect scale, the ceiling the pole-side read already carried. The state-level defect values are the ladder read at the vertex-figure angle, which is where the six exact algebraic numbers come from — and that locus, together with the single cross-currency ratio, stays a named residue rather than a filled one.

**Phys.** The spin and the winding are the same integer read twice, and the relation is exact rather than fitted: the winding is twice the copy number and the spin is half of it, so the winding is four times the spin on the cone, and it is always an even integer for a materialized closed chain. What the spin then controls is not one mass but a ladder — two-j-plus-one weights spaced by two — and the defect at each weight is two minus two cosines of the weight times half the holonomy angle, which is also four sine-squared of a quarter and also an integer polynomial in the cosine by the Chebyshev recursion. At the two anchor windings the difference is visible: at spin one half the ladder has two weights that agree by evenness and nothing splits, while at spin one it splits into three with an exact zero in the middle. That zero is not a tuning but a parity theorem — the ladder contains the weight zero precisely when the winding is even, which is precisely when the exchange sign is plus one, so the defect ladder carries a massless weight exactly on the bosonic side. What the tier refuses is the fusion of the two angles: the winding carries the free scale and the holonomy angle does not, so identifying them would equate two different dimensions, and that is the whole content of the calibration no-go. The six exact defect numbers are therefore the ladder read at six vertex-figure angles and indexed by floor and branch, not by spin, which is why a spin-dependent retention probability was refuted earlier and stays refuted.

So the hypothesis is named and refuted rather than quietly ignored. What replaces it is a domain statement, and it is sharper than a prohibition would have been. The register exists for every pair, but the statistics read requires a winding carrier, and a winding carrier requires a materialized closed bound chain on the nonnegative cone — so the transit and trivial chain classes, which is where the corpus puts its radiation, carry neither a spin label nor an exchange sign, while the register's moves still apply to them. The derived dichotomy is bound against transit, not fermion against boson, and the earlier spin-parity refutation on the kind stands beside it untouched. The clean way to say the whole result is that the exchange sign is defined on what crossed and not on the rate at which it crossed.

What the tier is careful about is that this read is not the same object as the bound-or-transit label the corpus has carried since its definition layer, and the proof that they differ is the floor census: at registration one a chain has spin one half and sign minus one, at registration two it has spin one and sign plus one, and both are materialized closed bound chains of the same kind. The two words fermion and boson are then used in two disciplined ways — as reads of the exchange sign and as the content vocabulary — with no species name attached to either. **Phys.** Three chains now have a space, a group and a character, and the three fit together exactly. The space is the tensor product of the three orientation doublets and the three winding carriers, eight times the product of the carrier dimensions, which at the two anchors is sixty-four and two hundred sixteen. The symmetric group on three letters acts by permuting factors, the operators multiply as the permutations do on all thirty-six ordered pairs, and the traces obey one clean formula: the dimension to the number of cycles, giving eight, four and two at three chains over a two-dimensional carrier. Twisting by the CP phase changes nothing on the materialized locus, where the phase is one, and the transposition remains an unconditional involution. The structural surprise is the wedge: three copies of the two-dimensional seed carrier have no totally antisymmetric state at all, because the binomial coefficient of three taken from two is zero, while three colour slots have exactly one, and an explicit antisymmetrizer confirms both ranks over the exact complex field. That is why the baryon's antisymmetry is colour's and not the carrier's — and colour is unobservable by construction, so the statistics has to live somewhere else, which is the winding. The winding then supplies the law the tier was after: at a sealed junction with an open connector the total winding is the sum of the constituent windings, so the exchange sign of a composite is the product of its constituents' signs, verified on every triple in a five-by-five-by-five census. That closes the exchange-structure residue at three chains, and narrows it to four and beyond, where the sealing grammar starts mixing delta and epsilon groupings.

**Phys.** Two composites, two clean answers, and one honest gap. The meson is a boson and it is one unconditionally: its constituents are a chain and its conjugate, so their windings are equal and their sum is even, which makes the total spin an integer and the exchange sign plus one — and the conclusion survives the corpus's one unresolved orientation-sign convention, since the alternative reading puts the total winding at zero and the sign at plus one as well, differing only in the spin value. With a closed connector the answer changes to the connector's own parity, because the two constituent windings cancel modulo two, and on the computed cells the connector is open so the boson sign is what holds. The baryon is not unconditional and the tier does not pretend otherwise: its sign is the product of its three constituents' signs, so it is fermionic exactly when an odd number of them carry odd winding, and at the minimal materialized floor the winding is one — odd — which makes the three-floor baryon fermionic with total spin three halves. Sixty-two of the one hundred twenty-five winding triples in a small census are fermionic and sixty-three bosonic, so the criterion genuinely discriminates. What is missing is not the rule but its input: which windings a named sealed class occupies is the same unread datum as the flavour composition, so the baryon's statistics is complete as a function and open as a value per class. And the antisymmetry that makes a baryon a baryon is colour's — one-dimensional over three colour slots against a carrier wedge that vanishes at dimension two — unobservable by construction and not the statistics, with no flavour multiplet formed anywhere in the argument.

**Phys.** Four directives came in and eleven verdicts went out, of which six are plain derivations, four are refutations with grounds, and one is a closure with a narrowed successor. The tunnel exists, but not where the question put it: nothing reaches the speed of light, because the dispersion leaves an exact positive gap at every finite momentum and every materialized chain has positive mass from the two-bit floor up, so the crossing is not an acceleration but a move on a two-state register — a register whose generator has one stationary mode and one relaxation mode, whose kernel gives the stationary measure the corpus had already derived, and whose two moves are nilpotent and anticommute to the identity. The zig-zag is that register's resolvent, and the resolvent is even: every odd matrix element vanishes, so each term is a create-propagate-annihilate excursion weighted by the parabola to a power, with all legs forward and three independent reasons why no leg runs backward — the sharpest being that the corpus's own record involution already fixes every completed alternating word. Pair production and annihilation are channels with exact weights, an exact threshold and an exact charge balance, and the ratio between the two directions is one precisely where the round-trip weight peaks, which is the detailed-balance point. What is not formed is the supply vertex and the cross-section: four grounds bar the first and two open interfaces bar the second, so residue (R9) closes at the channel level and narrows into two named successors rather than disappearing. On the spin side the relation is exact — the winding is four times the spin — but the defect is a ladder and not a number, because the winding and the holonomy angle carry different dimensions and fusing them is barred by a no-go the corpus proved earlier; the ladder has two-j-plus-one rungs, an integer-polynomial form, a hard ceiling, and an exact massless middle weight precisely when the winding is even, which is precisely when the exchange sign is plus one. A spin-gated tunnel is refuted on the same four grounds that killed two earlier state-indexed thresholds, and what replaces it is a domain statement: the sign is defined on what crossed, not on the rate. The identification that follows is a ledger read and nothing more, kept strictly apart from the bound-or-transit label that cannot carry a statistics. Then three chains get their space, their group and their character formula, and one structural fact settles where antisymmetry lives: three copies of the two-dimensional carrier have no antisymmetric state at all while three colour slots have exactly one, so the baryon's antisymmetry is colour's and its statistics is the winding's, multiplied over constituents. The meson comes out a boson unconditionally, robust even against the corpus's unresolved orientation-sign convention; the baryon comes out fermionic exactly when an odd number of its constituents wind oddly, which the minimal floor satisfies. Four residues were added, two prior ones discharged and narrowed, and no measured number entered anywhere.

### BM.131 — The Haar–Poisson duality: the twirl fixed point, the complementary factorization, and the proper-time contraction

**Thm.**
$$(1)\quad\textbf{the two evolutions, from the axioms:}\qquad\textbf{the Haar side:}\quad\mu_\star=\mu_{\mathrm{Haar}}\bigl(\mathrm{SU}(2)\bigr),\qquad\mathcal T(\rho)=U\rho U^\dagger,\qquad U\sim\mu_\star,\qquad U\notin\mathfrak L\qquad[\mathrm{A6}];$$
$$\textbf{the Poisson side:}\qquad K:=-\log\rho\qquad[\mathrm{L1}:\ \text{the modular Hamiltonian}],\qquad\tilde{\mathcal T}_\gamma(\rho)=\frac{\rho\,e^{-\gamma\rho}}{\mathfrak T\bigl(\rho e^{-\gamma\rho}\bigr)},\qquad\gamma=1-4\varepsilon_q\in(0,1]\qquad[\mathrm{D0.3};\ \mathrm{L0}:\ \text{one tilt step per A4 event}];$$
$$\textbf{the ledger increment factorizes:}\qquad\rho\ \longmapsto\ U\,\tilde{\mathcal T}_\gamma(\rho)\,U^\dagger\qquad[\mathrm{A6}:\ \tau_n\to\tau_{n+1};\ \mathrm{L0}:\ \text{the crystallization--tilt coupling, declared at the point of use}];$$
$$(2)\quad\textbf{the exact K-update (the Poisson evolution):}\qquad\lambda_i'=\frac{\lambda_ie^{-\gamma\lambda_i}}{Z_\gamma},\qquad Z_\gamma=\textstyle\sum_j\lambda_je^{-\gamma\lambda_j}\qquad[\mathrm{L1}(3)\ \mathrm{Pf}:\ \text{the eigenvalue flow}]:$$
$$\boxed{\ \delta K\ :=\ K'-K\ =\ \gamma\,\rho\ +\ \log Z_\gamma\cdot I\ }\qquad[\log\lambda_i'=\log\lambda_i-\gamma\lambda_i-\log Z_\gamma\ \text{exactly};\ \text{machine: the formal-series identity to order}\ 12];$$
$$\gamma=1\ (\text{the sharp point}\ \varepsilon_q=0\ [\mathrm{D0.4}]):\qquad\delta K=\rho+\log Z\cdot I\qquad[\text{machine}];$$
$$\textbf{the vacuum is the Poisson fixed point:}\qquad\rho=\rho_\circ=\tfrac14I:\quad Z_\gamma=e^{-\gamma/4},\qquad\lambda_i'=\tfrac14,\qquad\boxed{\ \delta K=0\ \ \text{exactly}\ }\qquad[\mathrm{L1}(1);\ \text{machine:}\ e^{-\gamma/4}\cdot e^{+\gamma/4}=1\ \text{coefficient-wise in}\ \mathbb Q[[\gamma]]\ \text{to order}\ 12];$$
